title: Regional Quality Assurance - India
description:
**Job Summary**
The role has oversight and governance of quality management systems, quality assurance and quality control for the manufacturing plants in India, and supports the local 3PM team for quality related assessments and service arrangements.
  
  
Responsible for administering and resourcing the programs and processes to address and resolve regional product quality complaints from customers and to provide normal technical assistance to customer product inquiries.
  
  
Lead India plant QC teams to effectively perform quality control activities and drive continuous improvement and adherence to quality standard work processes and global quality standards
  
  
Maintaining communication and alignment with business units, support functions, and manufacturing leaders to ensure regional quality initiatives are aligned with business strategy.
  
  
**Essential Duties And Responsibilities**

* Create and lead the India Quality Board, consisting of QC Leaders from India plants, to facilitate sharing of best practices, drive efficiency and standardization, and foster continuous improvement in quality control processes.
* Develop and promote a quality culture in India by engaging plant leadership teams, QC teams by promoting high motivation and supporting their professional development through appropriate training and resources.
* Ensure comprehensive understanding and consistent application of corporate, industry, and regulatory policies, standards and procedures across all India plants.
* Drive the deployment and ongoing enhancement of Standard Work Processes (SWP) for QC functions at all India plant locations.
* Support plant QC teams in investigation and resolution of non-conformance material (NCM) and product quality complaints. Serve as the focal point for communications and resolution of significant customer quality issues in India.
* Maintain regular communication and alignment with India Business Units, Supply Chain and Manufacturing leaders to provide updates on quality performance, Corporate QA strategies and initiatives, while also gathering feedback and understanding their requirements.
* Improve the overall QMS (Quality Management System) standards of India plants. Support the Global QMS Manager in implementing global initiatives in India.
* Lead a multi-disciplinary teams, when required, comprising plant QC, Process Technology, Technical Services, and customer technical assistane (CTA) teams to address quality concerns and drive improvements that better support business objectives.

**Skills, Experience, And Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree or above in Engineering, Chemistry, or related industrial field
* 15 Years manufactuirng, engineering, or quality Management
* 10 years of working experience in customer quality management
* 5 years of experience of managing teams or people internationally
* Fluent in English
* Familiar with ISO and FDA quality management systems
* Self motivated and results oriented
* Collaborative with the ability to influence
* Strategic, global perspective

Considered a Plus
  
  

* Lean/Six Sigma training and experience preferred
* Supply chain management experience
* Familiar with SAP/CRM ERP systems

title: Pharma QC / Purchase Engineer | Japanese Projects | MNC Background Mandatory | Japanese Project Experience Preferred | Vendor Development / Quality / Procurement | CTC Up to ₹8-10 LPA
description:
**Company Description**
VHA Biopharma Private Limited is committed to delivering quality healthcare solutions that make a meaningful difference in patients’ lives. The company focuses on effective cures across multiple therapeutic areas, including antibiotics, pain management, gastrointestinal treatments, gynecological products, and nutritional and health supplements. VHA strives to consistently satisfy both external customers and internal stakeholders through reliable, patient-centric products. The organization emphasizes continuous improvement and expansion into additional therapy categories as healthcare needs evolve.
  
**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site role based in the Mumbai Metropolitan Region for a Pharma QC / Purchase Engineer working on Japanese projects. The role involves overseeing quality control activities for pharmaceutical products and materials, ensuring adherence to regulatory standards and internal specifications. The individual will manage purchasing processes, including vendor evaluation, negotiation, and order placement, with a focus on MNC-level compliance and efficiency. Daily tasks include coordinating with Japanese project stakeholders, monitoring procurement timelines, maintaining documentation, and collaborating with cross-functional teams on vendor development, quality improvements, and cost-effective procurement strategies. The position requires close interaction with suppliers and internal departments to sustain quality, timely deliveries, and optimized supply chain performance.
  
**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong skills in Purchasing Processes and Purchase Management, with experience handling pharma-related procurement in an MNC environment.
* Candidates should possess skills in Purchase Planning and managing Purchase Orders, including scheduling, tracking, and documentation for domestic and international vendors.
* Candidates should possess solid Analytical Skills to evaluate supplier performance, cost structures, quality metrics, and project data for continuous improvement.
* Experience in pharmaceutical quality control, including raw material and finished goods inspection, validation, and GMP compliance.
* Exposure to Japanese projects or clients is preferred; familiarity with Japanese business practices, documentation standards, or language is an advantage.
* Proven experience in vendor development, technical evaluation of suppliers, and maintaining long-term, quality-focused supplier relationships.
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Pharmacy, or a related technical field; higher qualifications in supply chain or quality management are beneficial.
* Strong communication and coordination skills, attention to detail, and ability to work effectively in cross-cultural, cross-functional teams.
* Experience in ERP or procurement software, and proficiency in standard office tools for reporting and documentation.

title: System Engineer-Rail
description:
It has been more than 60 years since SYSTRA has garnered expertise that spans the entire spectrum of Mass Rapid Transit System. SYSTRA India’s valuable presence in India roots back to 1957, where SYSTRA worked on the electrification of Indian Railways. Our technical excellence, holistic approach and the tremendous talent provides a career that puts people who join us at the heart of improving transportation and urban infrastructure efficiency.
  
  
Understand better who we are by visiting www.systra.in
  
  
Context
  
  
CTR – Regional Technical Centre of Systra India takes care of the international production of major projects at Systra Group level. CTR team has expertise in design of High-Speed Rail, Metro, Conventional Rail, Bridges, Highways, Depots, Stations and Transport Planning. Starting from Feasibility/Concept stage to Detailed Design to IFC/Shop drawings, the disciplines involved have experience of designing in accordance with various international codes and delivered projects across the world.
  
  
CTR team has successfully delivered some major projects in UK, UAE, Tanzania, KSA, Australia, Canada and Denmark. One of the major achievements of India CTR team has been the design of HS2 project in UK. We played an instrumental role in delivering 3 major Sublots on HS2 with our teams proactively engaging with Front Office in UK and delivering beyond client expectations. This resulted in India team receiving many accolades from the contractor BBV and client HS2.
  
  
CTR team in India is proficient in working on multi-disciplinary projects integrating Design, BIM and Drawing production in a seamless workflow incorporating different software. The technical and management teams within CTR get an opportunity to work and interact with other CTR teams within Systra Group from Paris, Poland, Dubai, Philippines and Brazil.
  
  
Missions/Main Duties
  
  
**Job Summary**
We are seeking a competent and motivated Railway System Engineer to contribute to the delivery and integration of railway systems across international projects. The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of railway systems engineering, system architecture, requirements management, interfaces, verification and validation, safety, and systems integration across disciplines such as Signalling, Telecom, Electrical/OLE, SCADA, Rolling Stock, Track, and Operations.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and manage railway system requirements, system architecture, functional specifications, and technical documentation in accordance with applicable project and national standards.
* Support system engineering activities across the project lifecycle, from bid/tender and concept/design through integration, testing, commissioning, and project closure.
* Coordinate multidisciplinary interfaces and system integration between Signalling, Telecom, Electrical/OLE, SCADA, Rolling Stock, Track, Civil, and Operations.
* Prepare and maintain System Requirement Specifications (SRS), Interface Control Documents (ICD), System Architecture documents, compliance matrices, verification and validation plans, and other system engineering deliverables.
* Perform requirements analysis, traceability, allocation, impact assessment, and verification to ensure that system requirements are correctly implemented and demonstrated.
* Support RAMS and safety engineering activities in accordance with applicable standards, including CENELEC EN 50126, EN 50128, and EN 50129 where applicable.
* Contribute to technical reviews, design assurance, compliance assessments, lessons learned, and continuous improvement of system engineering processes and workflows.

Profile/Skills
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical, Electronics, Systems, Railway, Control & Instrumentation, or a related engineering discipline (Master’s preferred).
* 6–10 years of professional experience in railway systems engineering, systems integration, railway design, or a related discipline.
* Good understanding of railway system lifecycle, system engineering processes, requirements management, interface management, verification & validation, and configuration/change management.
* Experience working across one or more railway disciplines such as Signalling/ERTMS, Telecom, SCADA/OCC, Electrical/OLE, Rolling Stock, Track, or Operations.
* Exposure to international railway standards and client requirements, particularly Australia (ARTC/MTM), UK (Network Rail), and Sweden (Trafikverket).
* Understanding of ERTMS/ETCS, conventional signalling, railway telecom, SCADA/OCC, traction power/OLE, or other railway subsystems is an advantage.
* Familiarity with engineering and documentation tools such as MicroStation, AutoCAD, Microsoft Office, requirements-management tools, interface-management tools, or project collaboration platforms.
* Good understanding of safety-critical engineering, RAMS, hazard management, and regulatory/compliance requirements for railway systems.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, coordination, and technical documentation skills.

**Preferred Certifications**

* IRSE License or equivalent national/international railway certification.
* Certification or training in Systems Engineering, Requirements Engineering, RAMS, or Functional Safety.
* Knowledge or training in CENELEC railway standards (EN 50126/8/9).
* OEM-specific railway systems training (e.g., Siemens, Alstom, Hitachi, Thales, or equivalent).
* Relevant rail safety worker certifications such as RIW (Australia) or Sentinel (UK) are a plus.

We commit to put people who join us at the heart of improving transportation and urban infrastructure efficiency. As we are growing, this is time to be a part of this challenging adventure. It’s not a job - it’s a career!

title: Quality Assurance Lead
description:
**Job Description- Lead-Quality Assurance**

**Position:**

Lead – Quality Assurance & Quality Control (QA/QC)

**Company:**

Enweigh India Pvt. Ltd

**Department:**

Quality Assurance & Quality Control

**Experience:**

7–8 Years of relevant experience in Quality Assurance/Quality Control.


Experience in EPC, industrial equipment manufacturing, process plants, skid packages, instrumentation systems or power/chemical/oil & gas industries.

**Qualification**

: B.E./B.Tech. in Electrical & Instrumentation / Instrumentation / Electrical Engineering

**Reporting To: Head –**

Operations / Operations & Projects

**Location:**

Vasai, Andheri-Mumbai

**Employment type**

- Full Time

**Gende**

r-Male/Female.

We are looking for the experienced and motivated
**Lead-Quality Assurance having 07-08 years of work experience**

preferably from Boiler Industry, Process Industry, Chemical, Oil & Ga and Power Industry.

**JOB DESCRIPTION**

**1. Role Objective**

The Lead – Quality Assurance & Quality Control will be responsible for establishing, implementing and maintaining the company's overall Quality Management System and ensuring quality compliance across all project activities, including engineering, procurement, manufacturing, assembly, inspection, testing and project execution. The position will act as the primary quality coordination interface between internal departments, vendors, third-party inspection agencies and clients.

**2. Key Roles & Responsibilities**

Prepare, review and implement project-specific Quality Assurance Plans (QAPs), Inspection & Test Plans (ITPs) and inspection procedures.

Develop QAPs covering mechanical skids, piping, structural fabrication, electrical panels, instrumentation, cabling and control systems.

Review client specifications, purchase orders, approved drawings and applicable quality requirements before initiating project activities.

Ensure compliance with applicable EN standards, CE requirements and other relevant international codes.

**3. Vendor Quality Management & Inspection Coordination**

Coordinate with vendors and suppliers for quality requirements, inspections and documentation.

Review vendor quality plans, inspection procedures, material test certificates and technical documentation.

Plan and coordinate vendor inspections, stage inspections, pre-dispatch inspections and Factory Acceptance Tests (FATs).

Ensure inspection requests are raised on time, and inspections are completed as per approved QAPs and project schedules.

Monitor vendor quality performance and initiate corrective actions wherever required.

**4. Inspection, Testing & FAT**

Coordinate and witness mechanical, electrical and instrumentation inspections and testing activities.

Ensure inspection and testing of fabricated skids, piping, pressure components, electrical panels, instruments and control systems as per QAPs.

Verify compliance with approved drawings, specifications, datasheets and applicable standards.

Coordinate FAT activities for electrical panels, PLC/control systems, instrumentation and complete skid packages.

Ensure proper recording of inspection observations, test results and client approvals.

Ensure timely closure of client and third-party inspection observations


before material dispatch
**.**

**5. Quality Documentation & Project Quality Dossier**

Prepare, compile, review and maintain complete project-specific Quality Documentation Dossiers

Ensure dossiers are prepared in accordance with client specifications and contractual requirements.

Ensure final quality dossiers are submitted to clients within agreed project timelines.

**6. Non-Conformance Management & CAPA**

Identify, document and manage internal and external Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs).

Coordinate with concerned departments and vendors for root cause analysis.

Prepare and implement Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) plans.

**7. ISO 9001:2015 – Quality Management System**

Maintain and continuously improve the company's ISO 9001:2015 Quality Management System.

Ensure proper control of documents and records across departments.

Coordinate internal quality audits, external audits and surveillance audits.

**Knowledge of applicable European and international standards-**

EN standards relevant to mechanical and electrical equipment.

CE marking requirements and applicable EU directives/regulations.

EN 60204-1 – Safety of Machinery: Electrical Equipment of Machines.

IEC 61439 – Low-voltage switchgear and control gear assemblies.

Relevant ISO standards and project-specific codes.

**Required Skills & Competencies**

Strong technical understanding of electrical and instrumentation systems.

Good understanding of mechanical fabrication, piping, skid manufacturing and assembly processes.

Hands-on experience in preparation of QAPs, ITPs and quality documentation.

Experience in coordinating client inspections, vendor inspections and FATs.

Knowledge of ISO 9001:2015 implementation and audit requirements.

Understanding EN standards, IEC codes and CE compliance requirements.

Ability to interpret engineering drawings, electrical schematics, P&IDs and technical specifications.

Good communication and coordination skills to interact with international clients, vendors and inspection agencies.

title: Wholesale Credit Risk Associate
description:
**Job Description**
As part of Risk Management and Compliance, you are at the center of keeping JPMorganChase strong and resilient. You help the firm grow its business in a responsible way by anticipating new and emerging risks and using your expert judgment to solve real-world challenges that impact our company, customers, and communities. Our culture in Risk Management and Compliance is all about thinking outside the box, challenging the status quo, and striving to be best-in-class. In this role, you will be a key member of the iSPRESO Product Team within Wholesale Credit Risk Product, owning product workstreams end to end and partnering with credit risk teams, technology, data and AI partners, subject matter experts, and other stakeholders. You will help onboard portfolios, deliver new product features, and keep the financial data that credit monitoring, grading, and analytics depend on accurate and reliable.
  
  
As a
**Risk Associate**
within
**Risk Management and Compliance**
, you will be a key member of a credit risk product team owning product workstreams end to end, from requirements through production. You will partner with credit risk teams, technology partners, data partners, and subject matter experts to onboard portfolios and deliver new product features. You will help ensure the financial data used for credit monitoring, grading, and analytics is accurate and reliable. You will use data analysis and controls to identify issues early and support resolution through to closure. You will communicate clearly with stakeholders through demos, working sessions, and status updates.
  
  
Job responsibilities
  
  

* Own product workstreams end to end, from requirements through build, user acceptance testing, release, and production support
* Gather requirements from credit risk stakeholders and write clear user stories with acceptance criteria, user interface mockups, and test data
* Build and maintain financial data models and templates for portfolios (line items, formulas, validations), and onboard new portfolios with credit risk users and subject matter experts
* Source, map, and onboard vendor and market data and define how it flows into the product and to downstream consumers
* Define requirements for application programming interfaces, event feeds, and data lake views that downstream monitoring, grading, and analytics teams rely on, and validate what they receive
* Use SQL and Python to analyze data, reconcile product outputs against source systems and application programming interfaces, and set up controls that catch issues before users see them
* Apply large language model and artificial intelligence capabilities to product use cases, including large language model-based financial spreading, and use artificial intelligence tools to automate analysis, testing, and documentation
* Plan and run user acceptance testing with documented test evidence; triage production issues and ServiceNow tickets, drive root-cause analysis with technology, and see fixes through to closure
* Define and track product metrics and key performance indicators, deliver recurring and ad hoc reporting, and use the results to inform prioritization
* Run product demos, working group, and feedback sessions with stakeholders, and support release coordination and status communication
* Partner with solution architects and technologists on technical approaches, and help onboard and mentor new joiners and interns

Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills
  
  

* Bachelor's Degree in finance, economics, computer science, engineering, or a related field
* 3+ years of relevant work experience in credit risk, financial data, product, business analysis, or a related capacity
* Understanding of financial statements (balance sheet, income statement, cash flow, trailing twelve month and year to date periods) and their relevance for credit and banking use cases
* Hands-on SQL and Python (or similar) for analysis, mapping, and reconciliation of large datasets
* Experience writing clear requirements (user stories, acceptance criteria) and testing delivered features
* Strong, clear, and concise written and verbal communication skills, including summarizing analysis for senior stakeholders
* Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail; able to manage multiple workstreams and competing priorities under tight deadlines
* Proven ability to collaborate and build strong partnerships across business, technology, and data teams in a matrix organization
* Ownership mindset, intellectual curiosity, and a proven ability to learn quickly
* Experience using data and metrics to drive decisions

Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills
  
  

* Experience with data vendors and their application programming interfaces or feeds
* Familiarity with application programming interfaces, event streaming (for example Kafka), and data platforms (Oracle, data lakes, Databricks, or Dremio)
* Prior experience in implementation of artificial intelligence or large language model-based solutions or using artificial intelligence tools to automate work
* Experience creating user interface mockups and working with technology and user experience design colleagues on technical designs
* Experience with Agile delivery using JIRA and Confluence

title: Senior Executive
description:
Shop-Floor QA / GMP Compliance
  
  
Perform routine QA oversight of API manufacturing and packaging operations.
  
  
Ensure manufacturing activities are performed according to approved SOPs, BMR/BPR, specifications, and GMP requirements.
  
  
Conduct line clearance and area/equipment verification before commencement of manufacturing activities.
  
  
Monitor critical manufacturing activities and ensure compliance with approved process parameters.
  
  
Verify equipment status, cleaning status, calibration status, and area conditions.
  
  
Ensure proper identification and status labeling of raw materials, intermediates, solvents, finished products, and equipment.
  
  
Raise and document GMP observations and ensure timely corrective actions.
  
  

* Batch Documentation & Review

Review Batch Manufacturing Records (BMR), Batch Packaging Records (BPR), equipment logbooks, and associated GMP documents.
  
  
Ensure entries are complete, accurate, traceable, and contemporaneous.
  
  
Review manufacturing yields, reconciliation, process parameters, IPC results, and deviations.
  
  
Ensure batch documentation is completed and reviewed within the defined timelines.
  
  
Support batch disposition/release activities in coordination with QA management.
  
  

* Deviation, Investigation & CAPA

Initiate, review, and support investigation of deviations, incidents, OOS/OOT, process failures, and market complaints, as applicable.
  
  
Participate in root-cause analysis using appropriate investigation tools.
  
  
Prepare and monitor CAPA plans and verify effectiveness.
  
  
Ensure investigations are scientifically sound, properly documented, and completed within timelines.
  
  

* Change Control

Review and assess change controls related to manufacturing processes, equipment, facilities, materials, analytical methods, documents, and utilities.
  
  
Coordinate with Production, QC, Engineering, Regulatory Affairs, and other functions for impact assessment.
  
  
Monitor implementation of approved changes and ensure required documentation is completed.
  
  

* SOP & Quality System

Prepare, review, and revise SOPs, specifications, formats, protocols, and other quality documents.
  
  
Ensure implementation of the site Quality Management System.
  
  
Support periodic review of SOPs and controlled documents.
  
  
Ensure training is completed before implementation of new or revised procedures.
  
  

* Audit & Inspection Readiness

Support internal audits, customer audits, regulatory inspections, and GMP audits.
  
  
Prepare documents and records required for audits and inspections.
  
  
Track audit observations and support timely implementation and closure of commitments.
  
  
Maintain the assigned areas in an inspection-ready condition.
  
  

* Training & Compliance

Provide GMP and quality-system training to Production, QC, Warehouse, Engineering, and other relevant personnel.
  
  
Monitor compliance with data integrity and good documentation practices.
  
  
Promote a strong quality culture throughout the manufacturing area.
  
  

* Cross-Functional Coordination

Coordinate with Production, QC, Warehouse, Engineering, EHS, and Regulatory Affairs to resolve quality-related issues.
  
  
Provide QA guidance during manufacturing process deviations and abnormal events.
  
  
Support continuous improvement and risk-reduction initiatives.
  
  
Required Knowledge
  
  
Strong knowledge of ICH Q7, GMP, GDP, data integrity, and API manufacturing requirements.
  
  
Knowledge of BMR/BPR review and shop-floor QA activities.
  
  
Good understanding of deviations, CAPA, change control, OOS/OOT, investigations, and risk assessment.
  
  
Familiarity with regulatory expectations for API manufacturing.
  
  
Understanding of documentation practices and traceability requirements.
  
  
Key Skills
  
  
GMP and regulatory compliance
  
  
Batch record review
  
  
Deviation investigation
  
  
CAPA and change control
  
  
Root-cause analysis
  
  
Audit/inspection handling
  
  
Documentation and data integrity
  
  
Problem-solving and decision-making
  
  
Cross-functional coordination
  
  
Team leadership and communication
  
  
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
  
  
Timely and accurate batch record review
  
  
GMP compliance and reduction in recurring observations
  
  
Timely closure of deviations, CAPA, and change controls
  
  
Audit/inspection readiness and compliance
  
  
Effectiveness of investigations and CAPA
  
  
Training compliance
  
  
Data integrity and documentation compliance
  
  
Reduction in repeat deviations and quality incidents

title: Sr. D&T Analyst – Corporate Services
description:
**Company Overview**
We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. We look for people who want to bring their best — bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one another and grow together. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what’s next.
  
  
**Overview**
The Sr.Technical Analyst – Process Mining and Modeling is a senior individual contributor responsible for leading the technical delivery and lifecycle management of global process-mining and process-modeling solutions from technical intake through operational adoption. Working from defined business problems and requirements established with Process Owners and the business-facing process-mining role, this position translates business needs into scalable, data-driven solutions using SAP Signavio, SAP S/4HANA, enterprise resource planning systems, and related data platforms. The analyst owns the technical data foundation, solution design, configuration, technical validation, deployment, monitoring, maintenance, and enhancement of process-mining and process-modeling solutions. The role partners closely with process owners, the business-facing process-mining role, and technical stakeholders to ensure solutions are reliable, actionable, secure, and sustainable, while the business-facing role owns business interpretation, improvement action planning, and value realization across General Mills.
  
  
**Key Accountabilities**

* Lead technical intake, solution design, estimation, and delivery planning for global process-mining and process-modeling initiatives, building on business opportunities and requirements defined with Process Owners and the business-facing process-mining role.
* Partner with the business-facing process-mining role, Process Owners, and data owners to translate business requirements into technical requirements, data definitions, KPI logic, analytical acceptance criteria, and traceable solution designs.
* Design, build, and validate the data foundation required for process mining, including source-data preparation, event logs, connectors, transformations, integrations, and data-quality controls across SAP S/4HANA, ERP, and related data platforms.
* Configure and deliver SAP Signavio process-mining and process-modeling solutions, including process discovery, process analysis, and BPMN-based modeling where applicable, to produce reliable and actionable insights from approved business requirements.
* Provide strong technical leadership for workstreams and delivery partners by making solution decisions, setting technical direction, managing technical risks and dependencies, and ensuring quality across implementation activities.
* Lead technical testing, deployment, documentation, monitoring, maintenance, support, and continuous enhancement across the solution lifecycle; coordinate business validation and user acceptance with the business-facing process-mining role and Process Owners.
* Enable adoption through clear technical documentation, solution walkthroughs, capability guidance, and operational support. Partner with the business-facing process-mining role to support improvement outcomes, while maintaining clear D&T ownership of technical readiness, reliability, and sustainability.
* Establish and apply reusable technical standards, delivery practices, architecture principles, data-quality controls, release practices, and governance expectations for process-mining and modeling solutions.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems, engineering, or a related field.
* 12+ years of overall professional experience with at least 7–8 years as a Business Analyst or in a similar functional role.
* Seven or more years of experience in technical analysis, process mining, process modeling, data engineering, systems integration, or a related technology discipline.
* Process Mining and Modeling: Hands-on experience with process mining, process modeling, and process analysis, including translating defined business requirements into scalable technical solutions and validating that solutions meet intended business use.
* Data and Integration: Experience preparing, integrating, and validating enterprise data for process analysis, including event logs, data transformations, connectors, integrations, data-quality controls, and source-system dependencies.
* SAP Technology: Experience with SAP Signavio and SAP ERP or SAP S/4HANA environments, including the relationship between source-system data and process-mining solutions.
* Technical Delivery and Lifecycle Management: Experience leading technical testing, deployment, documentation, monitoring, maintenance, support, and continuous enhancement of enterprise technology solutions.
* Technical Leadership: Demonstrated ability to lead technical workstreams, coordinate delivery partners, make solution decisions, manage risks and dependencies, and communicate technical concepts clearly to technical and business stakeholders.
* Excellent communication, problem-solving, and analytical skills, with strong attention to detail.
* Proven expertise in stakeholder management, with ability to collaborate effectively across business and technical teams.
* Hands-on experience working in Agile environments, including backlog management, user story definition, and sprint planning.
* Ability to create clear and concise documentation, including process flows, user stories, and test cases.
* Knowledge of data governance tools and practices, with ability to apply governance principles to ServiceNow processes.
* Awareness of cybersecurity requirements related to enterprise platforms.
* Excellent analytical, communication, and influencing skills, with ability to translate complex business needs into actionable requiremets

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Technical Expertise: Advanced experience with SAP Signavio, including complex implementations, solution design, technical configuration, or development of reusable process-mining and process-modeling solutions.
* Process Modeling: Experience applying BPMN or other recognized process-modeling standards and notation, with the ability to implement models that accurately represent agreed business processes.
* Certifications: Process-mining, SAP Signavio, SAP, data, architecture, or Agile certifications.
* Continuous Improvement: Experience with Lean Six Sigma, continuous improvement,s or process-excellence methods and the ability to support technology-enabled improvement.
* Global Collaboration: Experience delivering global solutions with teams across regions and time zones.
* Stakeholder Leadership: Demonstrated ability to influence without direct authority and partner effectively with process owners, business-facing process-mining practitioners, data owners, and technical delivery partners while maintaining clear technical ownership

**ELIGIBILITY**
Applicants must meet minimum age qualifications in the country in which the job is located.

Position Overview

* **Job Title:**
  Advisory Coordinator – Sales Pipeline Data Analyst
* **Company:**
  EisnerAmper
* **Department:**
  Growth Team
* **Business Groups:**
  Advisory Services Group and Outsourced Services Group

* **Work Schedule:**

* **Work Arrangement:**
  Hybrid.
* **Location**
  : Mumbai

Role Overview

EisnerAmper is seeking a detail-oriented Sales Pipeline Data Analyst to support CRM data quality and pipeline management across its Advisory Services Group and Outsourced Services Group.

The candidate will be responsible for auditing, cleaning, maintaining, and validating sales pipeline data within NetSuite CRM and other approved CRM platforms.

The role involves identifying duplicate, incomplete, inaccurate, stale, and misclassified opportunity records, coordinating with business development professionals and practice leadership to resolve discrepancies, and ensuring reliable pipeline reporting, forecasting, and KPI tracking.

The ideal candidate will have hands-on CRM experience, strong Excel skills, excellent attention to detail, and an understanding of sales pipeline management and data quality processes.

Key Responsibilities

**CRM Data Management & Data Quality**

* Conduct regular audits of CRM and sales pipeline records.
* Identify and resolve duplicate, stale, incomplete, inaccurate, and non-compliant records.
* Maintain CRM data quality through daily, weekly, monthly, and quarterly hygiene activities.
* Validate opportunity fields, stages, ownership, close dates, service line coding, and originator attribution.
* Update and correct CRM records while ensuring compliance with established data standards.
* Investigate data discrepancies and escalate unresolved issues when necessary.

**Sales Pipeline Management**

* Monitor aging, stalled, dormant, duplicate, and misclassified opportunities.
* Coordinate with opportunity owners and stakeholders to obtain missing information.
* Ensure accurate opportunity classifications and timely updates.
* Support pipeline reporting, forecasting, and KPI accuracy.

**Reporting & Analytics**

* Prepare and distribute pipeline hygiene reports, scorecards, and exception reports.
* Support pipeline review meetings through data preparation and follow-up activities.
* Assist in creating and maintaining CRM reports, dashboards, and data quality monitoring tools.
* Identify recurring data quality trends and recommend improvements.

**Process Improvement & Documentation**

* Maintain CRM data quality procedures, SOPs, hygiene checklists, and field definitions.

title: Quality Controller- Video
description:
**Job Title: Video Quality Control (QC) – Adaptation**

**Role Overview**

The Video QC – Adaptation Specialist is responsible for ensuring the technical and creative accuracy of adapted video assets across multiple markets, languages, and platforms. This role plays a critical part in validating localized video content before final delivery, ensuring compliance with brand guidelines, broadcast standards, and platform specifications.

The ideal candidate has strong experience in post-production workflows, localization processes, and broadcast/digital technical standards.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Technical Quality Control**

* Perform frame-by-frame QC of adapted video assets.
* Check video and audio sync accuracy.
* Validate aspect ratios, resolution, frame rates, safe areas, and color consistency.
* Ensure correct encoding settings as per platform requirements (TV, OTT, social, digital).
* Identify compression artifacts, glitches, dropped frames, or rendering issues.

**2. Adaptation & Localization Review**

* Verify correct implementation of subtitles, supers, end cards, disclaimers, and legal text.
* Ensure language accuracy based on provided translation scripts (timing & placement check).
* Validate on-screen text alignment, font consistency, and regional adaptations.
* Confirm proper replacement of graphics, packshots, pricing, or regulatory information.

**3. Audio Checks**

* Review voiceover sync and pronunciation alignment.
* Ensure correct language tracks are used.
* Check audio levels meet broadcast/platform standards.
* Confirm background music and SFX integration are accurate post-adaptation.

**4. Compliance & Brand Governance**

* Ensure adherence to brand guidelines.
* Validate regulatory disclaimers for respective markets.
* Check mandatory legal supers and duration compliance.
* Ensure market-specific edits are correctly implemented.

**5. Documentation & Reporting**

* Maintain detailed QC reports with timecodes and issue descriptions.

title: Engineer - Agentic AI
description:
**Job Description:**

* Design and build agentic AI workflows & systems — multi-step, tool-using agents that plan, act, and self-correct to automate enterprise processes.
* Identify manual, repetitive, or complex business workflows and re-imagine them as reliable agentic solutions.
* Build and maintain agent orchestration and the tools, connectors, and integrations that let agents act on real enterprise systems.
* Build and own complete solutions end-to-end — front end, backend, and deployment — not just the AI/agent layer. Expect full-stack ownership.
* Design and implement RAG pipelines to ground agents in enterprise knowledge and data.
* Deploy and operate local / self-hosted LLMs, with a focus on fast, efficient inference at scale.
* Build and expose capabilities via MCP (Model Context Protocol) for tool and context integration.
* Engineer human-in-the-loop review and approval flows for high-stakes automated actions.
* Ensure AI systems are scalable, reliable, observable, and safe in production — with guardrails, validation, retries, graceful failure handling, and cost/budget caps to prevent runaway spend.
* Follow solid SDLC practices end to end: version control, code review, CI/CD, testing, and deployment.

**Minimum Qualifications and Experience:**

* 3–5 years of professional software / AI engineering experience, with demonstrable hands-on work building Agentic AI systems — not just calling an LLM API but building agents that plan and act over multiple steps.

**Required Skills:**

* Strong Python engineering skills.
* Hands-on experience with agent frameworks and orchestration — e.g., LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, AutoGen, CrewAI, or similar.
* Solid understanding of agentic harnesses / scaffolding — the execution loop, tool interfaces, context and memory management, and evaluation that make an LLM behave as a reliable agent.
* Proven experience building RAG systems — chunking, embeddings, vector databases, retrieval strategies, and grounding.
* Basic familiarity with local / self-hosted LLMs — faster inference, quantization techniques, and serving frameworks such as vLLM (a plus, not core).
* Hands-on experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol) for tool / context integration.
* Full-stack delivery experience — comfortable building a usable UI (React/Next.js or Streamlit) and a backend/API layer (FastAPI or Node.js) end-to-end.
* Strong grasp of core LLM application patterns: prompt engineering, tool / function calling, structured (JSON) output handling, context management, and evaluation.
* Comfort debugging non-deterministic systems and designing guardrails, validation, and fallbacks.
* Proficiency across traditional ML, NLP, Computer Vision, and Deep Learning fundamentals & techniques.
* A clear track record of deploying scalable AI solutions in production, not just building POCs.

* Clarity of security concepts - SSL and PGP encryptions etc
* Prefer to have experience in Groovy scripts.

At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.

title: Senior Associate - Cyber Security - VAPT
description:
**About Company:**

BDO is a global network of professional services firms with a presence in over 166 countries, revenue of over USD 14 billion, and experience of over 60 years. It's a leading service provider for the mid markets with client service at its heart.

BDO India Services Private Limited (or BDO India) is the India member firm of BDO International. BDO India offers strategic, operational, accounting and tax, and regulatory advisory & assistance for both domestic and international organizations across a range of industries. BDO India is led by more than 300+ Partners & Directors with a team of over 10,000 professionals operating across 14 cities and 20 offices. We expect to grow sizably in the coming 3-5 years, adding various dimensions to our business and multiplying and increasing the current team size multi-fold

**About Cyber:**

BDO India cyber security practice is one of the fastest growing areas of the business with significant ambition for the future through additional recruitment and acquisition. As part of our cyber team / VAPT you will be managing teams and projects delivering advisory and technical support to help our clients to improve their information / cyber security posture and respond to the dynamic nature of technology risks / cyber security threats. Furthermore, often carryout out IT Risk Assessments in line with industry “better” practices (NIST / ISF / Cloud Security / etc.), regulatory mandates (RBI / IRDAI), and various compliance standards focusing on Vulnerability Assessments and Penetration Testing.

**Experience and Qualification:**

* 2-6 Years of experience in
  **VAPT (Vulnerability Assessment and Penetration Testing)**
* Graduate / Postgraduate in Engineering, computer science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Business, or a related field.
* VAPT-related certifications (e.g., CEH, OSCP, OSCE, GPEN or equivalent).

**Responsibilities:**

* Lead and mentor a team of cybersecurity consultants and analysts.
* Allocate work, monitor project progress, and ensure timely delivery of engagements.
* Review penetration testing reports and technical deliverables to maintain quality standards.
* Coach junior team members through technical reviews, knowledge-sharing sessions, and hands-on mentoring
* Serves as technical lead or subject matter specialist on Cyber Security Assessment projects covering either vulnerability assessment & penetration testing, network security architecture review, secure configuration/code review, firewall ruleset reviews
* Experience with Vulnerability Management tools: Kali Linux, Acunetix, AppScan, Nexpose, Qualys Guard, Nessus, Nmap, Metasploit, Fortify, etc.
* Manage day-to-day client relationships at mid and lower levels.
* Good knowledge of TCP/ IP and Networks, including Firewalls, IDS/IPS, Routers, Switches, and network architecture
* Experience in Infrastructure Penetration Testing and Application Security Testing
* Demonstrates ability to work independently on projects with limited supervision and lead a small team with assistance from Managers
* Experience in Secure Code Review
* Experience conducting Network Security Architecture Reviews and configuration reviews of Windows, Linux, UNIX, Solaris, Databases, etc.
* Experience in basic scripting such as Shell, Python, PERL, etc.
* Strong analytical and communication skills (written, verbal, and presentation)
* Open to learning new tools and technologies as per the project requirement
* Interactive with team members and confident during client meetings under the guidance of senior members of the project
* Be deadline-oriented and quality-focused
* Certification: OSCP, OSCE, GPEN, CEH etc.
* Familiarity with industry standards and frameworks such as OWASP, CIS, and ISO27001 Key

**Technical Skills:**

* Hands-on experience performing Network, Web, API, Mobile, and Thick Client application security testing.
* Proficient in using manual and automated application and network security tools such as Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP, Acunetix, ffuf, wfuzz, nikto, Nmap, and Nessus.
* Basic Knowledge of programming languages like C/C++, C#, JAVA, and ASP.NET, and familiarity with PERL/Python Scripting.
* Basic Knowledge of the cloud environment and its various components.
* Familiar with OWASP and Secure SDLC standards.
* Offensive security skill sets include backdoors, keyloggers, password dumpers, and spear phishing payloads.
* Deliver Red Team Exercises and augment Senior Red Teamers.
* Knowledge of standard security requirements within ASP.NET applications.
* Good Knowledge of TCP/IP, Network Security.
* Ability to automate certain security test cases or write PoC using a scripting language (Python, Shell Script, Ruby/Perl, etc.) wherever required
* Knowledge/experience in code review

**The opportunity**
We’re looking for Senior with expertise in ServiceNow Implementation to join the EYD GDS ServiceNow. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm whilst being instrumental in the growth.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Performs Configuration/Customization of the ServiceNow system, including creation workflows
* Builds service request fulfilment workflow from customer requirements including requests, request items and tasks using workflows, UI actions, client scripts, business rules, etc
* Uses scripting tools and Service Now functionality to automate rote tasks
* Performs integrations and process automation using Orchestration, Web Services, Soap calls, etc.
* Gathers specifications from the business departments and delivers a product/release that meets the needs presented. Interprets business and functional requirements and develops technical specifications documentation
* Load, manipulate and maintain data between Service-now and other systems as needed
* Work with business liaison to generate dashboards, home pages, performance analytics data collectors and reports as needed
* Must analyse and fully understand user stories and internal procedures in order to improve system capabilities, automate process workflows and address scheduling limitations throughout the development and delivery of the ServiceNow releases
* Performs system and integration testing with sample and live data

* Authentication protocols such as Active Directory / LDAP or SiteMinder federation /Azure
* Disciplined Agile Delivery software release build/deploy processes
* Integrating with internal and external applications and systems
* JavaScript, HTML, Angular JS and good web design practices
* Service Portal implementation experience
* Implementation experience on any of the following applications like Agentic AI, Gen AI, ITOM/HRSD/CSM/SPM/SecOps/IRM/ITSM, Flow designer, HAM, SAM, Integration, ITAM, Service Now Portal/UI Builder, SPM.
* Implementation experience on Performance Analytics.
* Knowledge of digital technologies like Machine learning, AI, IOT, Blockchain

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* College degree in related technology field (Computer, Engineering, Science, etc.) or comparable job experiences
* Approximately 4 to 6 years of experience in a development role. Able to exhibit a progression of increasingly complex job responsibilities during the period
* ServiceNow CSA certification plus any CIS is mandatory
* ITIL foundations certification a plus

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Experience on SDLC or TFS or JIRA or equivalent tool to maintain stories.
* Knowledge about ServiceNow’s latest version’s features.

**What We Look For**

* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
* An opportunity to be a part of market-leading, multi-disciplinary team of 250+ professionals, in the only integrated global transaction business worldwide.

title: Functional lead- OFSAA
description:
Job Description – OFSAA Consultant

Experience: 3–8 Years

Location: Mumbai

Employment Type: Full-Time

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced OFSAA Consultant with strong expertise in functional testing of Oracle Financial Services Analytical Applications (OFSAA), particularly Profitability Management and IFRS 9 applications. The candidate will be responsible for validating business functionalities, executing test scenarios, identifying defects, and ensuring application quality in line with business requirements.

Key Responsibilities

* Perform functional testing of OFSAA Profitability Management and IFRS 9 applications.
* Understand business requirements, functional specifications, and application workflows.
* Prepare and review test scenarios, test cases, and test data based on business requirements.
* Execute functional, regression, and integration testing.
* Validate application outputs, calculations, reports, and business rules against expected results.
* Perform data validation and reconciliation using SQL queries.
* Identify, document, track, and retest defects in coordination with development and business teams.
* Support defect triage, root-cause analysis, and issue resolution.
* Coordinate with business analysts, developers, and other stakeholders during testing cycles.
* Prepare test execution reports, defect summaries, and testing sign-off documentation.
* Support UAT activities and ensure timely closure of testing deliverables.

Required Skills and Qualifications

* 5–8 years of overall experience in IT, with relevant experience in OFSAA functional testing.
* Hands-on experience in functional testing of OFSAA Profitability Management and IFRS 9 applications.
* Good understanding of banking and financial services business processes.
* Knowledge of IFRS 9 concepts, including expected credit loss (ECL), impairment, and related calculations.
* Understanding of profitability management concepts, including cost allocation, profitability analysis, and financial calculations.
* Strong SQL skills for database validation and data reconciliation.
* Experience in test case preparation, execution, defect management, and regression testing.
* Good analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
* Ability to work independently and collaborate with cross-functional teams.

title: Senior Data Research Analyst
description:
**The Role**
As a Senior Research Analyst, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring the integrity and accuracy of our Fixed Income data and analytics. Working closely with Fixed Income Methodology Analysts, Product Managers, and Engineering teams, you will design and implement robust validation checks that uphold the quality of our production environments. Your strong analytical background will enable you to review production code critically, ensuring methodologies are correctly translated into system processes and that models perform effectively.
  
  
You will be responsible for developing quality assurance frameworks, monitoring data health, and validating new data content and analytics to maintain high standards throughout the entire data lifecycle. Additionally, you will manage client escalations by performing detailed root cause analysis and collaborating with internal teams to resolve issues efficiently.
  
  
This role requires a proactive individual with a strong understanding of Fixed Income markets, data science tools, and end-to-end data processes to help drive data accuracy, reliability, and insightful analysis..
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, and maintain a comprehensive QA framework for Fixed Income data and analytics, including monitoring data processes, data completeness, accuracy, and timeliness.
* Consistently improve upon existing model validation and QA processes, with an eye toward automation, efficiency, and robustness. Leverage Data Science, AI, and Large Language Models (LLMs) where possible to enhance analysis and generate actionable insights.
* Create and implement validation strategies for new data sets and analytical outputs, integrating these checks seamlessly into production environments.
* Oversee the full lifecycle of vendor data—from ingestion through to analytics and insights production—to ensure all outputs meet defined quality and accuracy standards.
* Validate the accuracy and integrity of Fixed Income calculations, metrics, and models to ensure they align with established methodologies. Collaborate closely with Quantitative Analysts, Product Managers and Engineering teams to understand methodologies, resolve issues, and drive continuous improvements.
* Handle client escalations by conducting thorough root cause analysis and facilitating timely communication and resolution with relevant stakeholders.
* Maintain a deep understanding of Morningstar’s Fixed Income data models and infrastructure, ensuring end-to-end data quality from collection to reporting.

**Requirements**
**Education & Experience:**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Finance, Economics, Data Science, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field.
* Minimum 3 years of experience as a Research Analyst, Data Analyst, or similar role within Fixed Income or Financial Services.
* Strong background in financial data analysis, particularly Fixed Income products and methodologies.

**Technical Skills**

* Required: Proficiency in SQL
* Preferred: Proficiency in coding and reviewing production-level code in at least one statistical modeling language (Python or R) for validation and quality assurance purposes.
* Experience developing QA frameworks for large datasets and complex analytics.
* Familiarity with data validation techniques, anomaly detection, and root cause analysis.
* Knowledge of data science, AI, and LLM tools for data insights and anomaly detection.
* Understanding of data lineage, data infrastructure, and end-to-end data pipeline management.
* Hands-on experience with vendor data integration and quality monitoring.
* Strong understanding of Fixed Income market instruments, calculations, and metrics.
* Ability to interpret and ensure methodologies are correctly implemented in code and production environments.
* Familiarity with Morningstar data models and their end-to-end lifecycle is a plus.

Morningstar is an equal opportunity employer.
  
  
Morningstar's hybrid work environment gives you the opportunity to collaborate in-person each week as we've found that we're at our best when we're purposely together on a regular basis. In most of our locations, our hybrid work model is four days in-office each week. A range of other benefits are also available to enhance flexibility as needs change. No matter where you are, you'll have tools and resources to engage meaningfully with your global colleagues.

title: Junior Content Manager
description:
**About the role**

We are looking for a Junior Content Manager with 4+ years of experience to handle day-to-day content management, QA, and operational delivery.

In this hybrid role, you will connect the dots between operational planning, team collaboration, and flawless delivery execution. You will ensure digital assets and web/app platforms are built to the highest quality, maintain and govern client content across enterprise CMS platforms, and drive operational delivery to ensure milestones and releases are executed smoothly, on time, and within scope.

You will collaborate closely with international cross-functional teams, working on a daily basis with stakeholders, project managers, developers, designers, analysts and SEO specialists in both Mumbai and Sweden.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Project Delivery & Release Management**

* Milestone & Sprint Coordination: Partner with project managers, stakeholders and team members to track task progress, manage sprint backlogs, and ensure team deliverables meet target deadlines.
* Release & Launch Management: Oversee website and campaign go-lives, coordinate cutover activities, maintain pre-/post-launch deployment checklists, and manage rollout schedules.
* Stakeholder Bridge: Serve as a reliable point of contact between technical teams (developers, designers) and non-technical stakeholders (client marketing teams, regional managers).
* Delivery Governance & Risk Tracking: Proactively identify bottlenecks, scope challenges, and delivery risks; facilitate issue resolution and communicate project health and status updates clearly.

**2. Quality Assurance & Testing**

* End-to-End Testing: Plan, write, and execute comprehensive test scenarios, test cases, and checklists across brand sites, campaign portals, customer portals, and mobile apps.
* Cross-Platform & Responsive Testing: Conduct thorough responsive, functional, cross-browser, cross-device, and regression testing to uncover critical defects early.
* UX & Usability Verification: Validate that digital experiences adhere strictly to design guidelines, usability best practices, and client expectations.
* Bug Lifecycle Management: Log clear, reproducible bug reports in Jira/tracking tools, prioritize fixes with developers, and verify defect resolutions.
* UAT Facilitation: Support client and internal User Acceptance Testing (UAT), triaging feedback and driving resolution before final sign-off.

**3. Content Management & Digital Operations**

* CMS Operations: Manage, author, and publish rich digital content across enterprise platforms (primarily Optimizely / Episerver, as well as WordPress, SAP Hybris, or similar systems).
* Content QA & Integrity: Ensure formatting, typography, digital media, links, metadata, and localized content meet brand guidelines and SEO standards before publishing.
* Regional Enablement & Training: Onboard new client market regions onto the CMS and provide user guidance, documentation, and troubleshooting support.
* Knowledge Base Documentation: Write, review, and regularly update help articles and guides in the knowledge base to keep information accurate for the team and our clients.

**Requirements (must-haves)**

* Experience: 4+ years of hands-on experience in a digital agency, consultancy, or product environment combining CMS content operations, web QA testing, and delivery/coordination tasks.
* CMS Expertise: Demonstrated experience managing content in modern CMS platforms (e.g., Optimizely/Episerver, WordPress, Drupal, SAP Email Marketing, or similar).
* QA & Testing Foundations: Strong understanding of testing methodologies, test-case authoring, defect tracking (Jira/Azure DevOps), and web UI/UX standards.
* Web Basics: Solid foundational understanding of HTML, CSS, web architecture, and how front-end components behave across devices and browsers.
* Project Delivery Skills: Proven ability to manage task boards, track deliverables, facilitate deployments, and coordinate between distributed teams.
* Communication: Exceptional verbal and written English communication skills; comfortable presenting to and collaborating directly with international/European stakeholders.
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, Digital Media, or equivalent practical experience.

**Nice-To-Haves (blow our minds)**

* Prior hands-on experience with Optimizely (formerly Episerver) and/or SAP Email Marketing.
* Familiarity with API testing tools (e.g., Postman) or test automation basics.
* Understanding of technical SEO fundamentals and web accessibility standards (WCAG).
* Basic image editing skills using Photoshop, Figma, or similar design tools.
* Agile/Scrum certifications (e.g., Certified ScrumMaster, CAPM, or Agile PM).

**Perks & Benefits**

* International setting: You will work with colleagues from Sweden and India.
* Non-hierarchical workplace. We believe good ideas come from everywhere and make sure to listen to everyone.
* 25 days of vacation yearly.
* Wellness allowance of 25,000 INR, to spend yearly on gym, yoga or other wellness activities.
* Lunch and snacks provided by the company.
* We operate five days a week, eight hours a day, following standard Indian business hours (IST).
* We follow a hybrid model and give you the possibility to work from home three days a week!

title: SAP SD-Staff
description:

Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.

**SAP SD Staff Consultant**

This role is well suited for professionals with
**1–3 years of relevant experience**
who thrive in collaborative environments and are interested in building strong SAP functional expertise. The position requires a good understanding of
**SAP SD and Order-to-Cash processes,**
exposure to
**Industry Solution – Oil & Gas**

* Participate in requirement-gathering discussions with business users and project teams.
* Support configuration, testing, defect resolution, deployment, and application support activities across the SAP SD/OTC landscape.
* Collaborate with cross-functional SAP teams to support seamless end-to-end business processes.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Good knowledge of the SAP SD module, including Sales, Shipping, Billing, Pricing, Credit Management, Outputs, and core functionalities.
* Good understanding of Downstream Oil & Gas business processes and industry best practices.
* Exposure to industry-specific Oil & Gas requirements such as exchange agreements, throughput agreements, and customer-specific pricing models.
* Ability to understand Oil & Gas business requirements and support their translation into scalable SAP S/4HANA solutions.
* Collaborate with MM, FI, IS-Oil, and logistics teams to support seamless end-to-end downstream integration.
* Work closely with senior consultants and project teams to ensure solution consistency, quality standards, and adherence to SAP best practices.
* Ability to prepare functional specifications for development requirements under appropriate guidance.
* Relevant experience or exposure to SAP SD implementation, rollout, enhancement, or support projects would be preferred.
* SAP SD certification is highly desirable and will be considered an added advantage.
* Good understanding of SAP SD configuration, including Third Party processes, Individual Purchase Orders, Sales BOM, and Variant Configuration.
* Exposure to S/4HANA advanced functionalities such as Advanced ATP, Advanced Returns Management, Settlement Management, and Interfaces.
* Working knowledge or exposure to IDOCs, LSMW, Batch Jobs, and SAP Queries.
* Good Order-to-Cash process exposure, including Make-to-Order and Make-to-Stock scenarios.
* Good understanding of integration with other SAP modules such as FICO, MM/LES, QM, WM and PP.
* Understanding of business process mapping and documentation.
* Knowledge or exposure to integration with Customer Service processes, including repair sales and warranty management.
* Basic proficiency in ABAP, including an understanding of function modules and ABAP debugging.
* Ability to interact with end users to understand requirements and prepare unit test cases and supporting documentation.
* Relevant industry domain exposure, preferably within Oil & Gas, will be advantageous.
* Good verbal and written communication skills.
* Exposure to global assignments or geographically distributed project teams will be an added benefit.
* Ability to participate effectively in both functional and technical discussions.
* Good interpersonal skills with the ability to work independently on assigned tasks while collaborating effectively with the broader project team.
* Support project activities throughout the implementation and support lifecycle, including requirements, configuration, testing, deployment, and post-go-live support.
* Collaborate closely with Solution/Project Teams to support the smooth transition of new solutions and participate in local and global development initiatives as required.
* Team player with a collaborative and creative approach to problem-solving.
* Demonstrates initiative, willingness to learn, adaptability, and creativity in work assignments.

The technical coverage above deliberately preserves the Senior JD's key skill areas, including SAP SD, OTC, S/4HANA, Third Party processing, Sales BOM, Variant Configuration, Advanced ATP, Advanced Returns Management, Settlement Management, IDOCs, LSMW, ABAP debugging, Customer Service integration, and FICO/MM/LES/QM/WM/PP integration.
  
  
**What We Offer You**

title: Sr Clinical Quality Specialist
description:
Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.
  
  
**A Day in the Life**
The Clinical Quality function partners with clinical study teams to ensure compliance with global regulatory requirements, Good Clinical Practice (GCP), and Medtronic quality standards across medical device clinical investigations and evaluations. The team supports audit execution, inspection readiness, quality oversight, vendor compliance, and corrective and preventive action management to help ensure the integrity and reliability of clinical data used for regulatory submissions.
  
  
This is a remote position supporting global clinical quality activities. The role requires frequent collaboration with internal stakeholders, healthcare professionals, clinical sites, hospitals, contract research organizations, third-party vendors, and external partners. Travel of up to 60%, including domestic and international travel, is required. Candidates should be located within reasonable proximity to a major airport, preferably an international airport.
  
  
The Sr Clinical Quality Specialist plans and executes clinical quality assurance activities supporting medical device clinical studies. This role independently conducts audits of clinical studies, investigational sites, hospitals, and third-party vendors to assess compliance with applicable regulations, Good Clinical Practice (GCP), and company procedures. The position also supports inspection readiness activities, quality investigations, and corrective and preventive action programs to strengthen compliance across clinical operations.
  
  
Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned.
  
  

* Plan, conduct, and document audits of clinical studies, Medtronic internally, investigational sites, hospitals, and third-party vendors.
* Assess compliance with regulatory requirements, Good Clinical Practice (GCP), and company quality standards.
* Evaluate the accuracy, completeness, and quality of clinical study data supporting medical device regulatory submissions.
* Conduct quality and compliance investigations and recommend corrective and preventive actions (CAPA).
* Track audit observations and CAPA activities through implementation and closure.
* Audit clinical systems, operational processes, and procedures to identify compliance risks and improvement opportunities.
* Support regulatory inspections, inspection readiness activities, and responses to audit or inspection findings.
* Maintain audit documentation, quality records, metrics, and reports in accordance with quality system requirements.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree with 4+ years of experience OR Advanced degree with 2+ years of experience in clinical quality, clinical research, auditing, or regulatory compliance.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience independently conducting audits of clinical studies within a regulated healthcare industry.
* Experience auditing clinical sites, hospitals, contract research organizations (CROs), and/or third-party vendors.
* Experience with Good Clinical Practice (GCP), clinical study regulations, and quality systems.
* Ability to travel up to 60% domestically and internationally and work remotely from a location with access to a major airport.
* Experience supporting medical device clinical studies.
* Experience within the medical device, pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or consulting industry supporting MedTech clients in a clinical quality, auditing, compliance, or clinical research capacity.
* Experience supporting regulatory authority inspections and inspection readiness activities.
* Certification in quality auditing, clinical research, or quality management systems.
* Experience managing quality investigations and corrective and preventive action (CAPA) programs.

**Physical Job Requirements**
The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees assigned to this position, but they are not an exhaustive list of all the required responsibilities and skills of this position.
  
  
‌
  
  
‌
  
  
**Recruitment Fraud Alert**
We are aware of phishing scams targeting job seekers. Please keep the following in mind:
  
  
Apply only through official Medtronic channels. All legitimate Medtronic recruiting communications come from approved Medtronic platforms and official @medtronic.com email addresses.
  
  
Medtronic will never ask for payment or sensitive personal information (such as bank account or Social Security details) during early stages of the hiring process. Any such requests are not legitimate.
  
  
If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Medtronic, do not respond, click links, or open attachments.
  
  
If you have any questions, concerns regarding the authenticity of a communication alleged to have been made by or on behalf of Medtronic, please contact us immediately at AskHR@medtronic.com.
  
  
**Benefits & Compensation**
**Medtronic offers a competitive Salary and flexible Benefits Package**
A commitment to our employees lives at the core of our values. We recognize their contributions. They share in the success they help to create. We offer a wide range of benefits, resources, and competitive compensation plans designed to support you at every career and life stage.

title: QUALITY ASURANCE & QUALITY CONTROL ( CORPORATE )
description:
**Company Description**
YORS PHARMACEUTICALS is a growing organization in the pharmaceutical sector, focused on delivering high-quality, safe, and effective medicines to patients and healthcare providers. The company emphasizes strong quality systems and compliance with national and international regulatory standards. Team members collaborate across departments to support consistent product quality, continuous improvement, and robust documentation practices. Working at YORS PHARMACEUTICALS offers the opportunity to contribute to patient safety while developing a career in a structured, process-driven environment.

**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site QUALITY ASSURANCE & QUALITY CONTROL (CORPORATE) role based in Mumbai. The role involves overseeing and implementing corporate QA/QC procedures, ensuring adherence to Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) and relevant regulatory guidelines. Day-to-day responsibilities include reviewing and approving standard operating procedures (SOPs), batch manufacturing records, validation documents, and change controls. The professional will coordinate internal audits, support external inspections, monitor quality metrics, and participate in root cause analysis and corrective and preventive actions (CAPA). The role also includes collaborating with manufacturing, regulatory, and R&D teams, maintaining documentation, training staff on quality standards, and supporting continuous improvement initiatives across corporate functions.

**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong knowledge of Quality Assurance practices, including GMP, GLP, documentation control, deviation management, and CAPA.
* Candidates should possess capabilities in Quality Control operations, such as sampling procedures, testing protocols, review of analytical data, and laboratory compliance.
* Candidates should possess skills in regulatory and compliance areas, including familiarity with national and international regulatory guidelines, audit readiness, and support for regulatory submissions.
* Candidates should possess competencies in process improvement and risk management, including root cause analysis, trend analysis of quality metrics, and implementation of corrective actions.
* Candidates should possess strong communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills to work effectively with cross-functional teams and support training on quality systems.
* Relevant qualifications may include a bachelor’s or master’s degree in Pharmacy, Chemistry, or a related scientific discipline, with prior experience in pharmaceutical QA/QC preferred.
* Additional beneficial skills include proficiency with quality management systems (QMS software), familiarity with data integrity principles, and experience in corporate or multi-site quality coordination.
