title: Demand Planning SME - o9 IBP & SOE
description:
**Job Description**
**Are You Ready to Make It Happen at Mondelēz International?**
**Join our Mission to Lead the Future of Snacking. Make It Possible.**
You will develop the 0-24-month IBP forecast by brand and at the stock keeping unit (SKU) level. You will coordinate, challenge and influence building block with input from sales, marketing and other partners. In addition, you will review the disaggregated short-term demand plan, which includes SKU/location mix and weekly pacing. Finally, you will provide the finalized detailed demand plan by SKU to supply planners and adjust it based on feedback from supply planners or commercial teams.
  
  
**How You Will Contribute**
You will:
  
  

* Contribute to the demand management cycle of the integrated business planning (IBP) process for your categories and to strategy and structure discussions
* Liaise with the commercial and operational teams and develop ways to continuously improve communication between the functions to support the delivery of the business KPIs for their families
* Manage forecast compilation process, which includes owning the short-term weekly plan and the long-term forecast (three or more months)
* Interact with modelling team to generate statistical forecasting
* Participate in the integrated business planning process and manage the demand planning tool
* Perform root-cause analysis for continuous plan improvement for key service issues, forecast error and bias, and share output with appropriate leadership

**What You Will Bring**
A desire to drive your future and accelerate your career and the following experience and knowledge:
  
  

* Experience in a fast-moving consumer goods or consumer packaged goods environment, preferably in food or other fast moving, dynamic industry where shelf life is a constraint
* Experience within an IBP/S&OP environment
* Able to influence cross-functional teams, working on priorities and improving the plan
* Excellent problem-solving skills, analytical skills – and able to understand and interpret data
* Strong verbal and written communication skills
* Team player who can work with many other functions on a daily basis

**More About This Role**
**What you need to know about this position:**
You will be an integral part of the implementation and go-live of the new planning solution (o9) within the AMEA region, with a primary focus on executing Integration Testing (I Test), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), data validation, and end-user training. You will work closely with the BU Champion and regional SME leads to ensure the solution is thoroughly tested, validated, and ready for business adoption. Meanwhile, as an early foundation of demand analysis role, this role would require business insights to deep dive into forecast error reasons and improve the AIML/Operation fcst KPI with BU team.
  
  
**What extra ingredients you will bring:**

* Solid understanding of Demand Planning processes (statistical forecasting, consensus planning, demand sensing)
* 4–8 years of relevant experience in Supply Chain Planning or a related operational role
* Familiarity with planning tools/systems; exposure to advanced planning solutions (o9, Kinaxis, OMP, SAP IBP) is a necessity.
* Strong attention to detail — ability to execute test scripts methodically and identify data discrepancies
* Comfortable working with testing tools (qTest, Jira) and documenting test results and defects
* Good communication skills — ability to train and support peers in a clear, structured manner
* Collaborative mindset with ability to work in cross-functional, multi-market teams under tight timelines
* Growth mindset, quick learner, and comfortable navigating ambiguity in a fast-paced transformation environment
* Proficiency in English; additional regional language skills are a plus

**Education / Certifications:**
Bachelor's Degree or postgraduate. With relevant Demand planning experience.
  
  
**Job specific requirements:**
The Demand Planning SME will serve as the BU's dedicated testing and adoption resource for the o9 Demand Planning module. Reporting into the region DP transformation lead, this role is responsible for executing test scripts, validating data integrity, supporting training delivery, and ensuring seamless transition from testing to go-live. The SME will act as the first line of support for end users, bridging the gap between the technical implementation team and the business, and championing user confidence and adoption of the new platform.
  
  
**Testing & Validation**

* Execute Integration Test (iTest) and UAT test scripts end-to-end for Demand Planning processes, ensuring 100% script coverage as per the test strategy
* Validate pre-load and post-load data accuracy during User Cutover Testing (UCUT), flagging discrepancies and coordinating resolution with the data and cutover teams
* Perform security role validation — test user access, roles, and permissions ahead of each testing phase
* Log, track, and follow up on defects in qTest/Jira, ensuring timely resolution within SLA and supporting retesting of failed test cases
* Execute E2E (End-to-End) scenario testing including cross-stream scenarios with Data Science, Supply Planning, and IBP
* Support pre-test preparation including batch job readiness, test script pre-requisites documentation, and environment checks
* Participate in daily testing war rooms, morning kick-offs, and end-of-day recaps to report progress, blockers, and pass rates

**Training & Change Adoption**

* Support the delivery of Pre-UAT and UAT training sessions for BU end users, including o9 system basics, Day-in-the-Life (DILO) walkthroughs, and advanced DP system training
* Conduct shadow testing sessions — walk end users through test scripts and o9 navigation to build familiarity and confidence
* Act as a go-to resource for end users during testing phases, providing real-time guidance on o9 processes and ways of working
* Support the BU Champion in driving change management activities, user communications, and adoption governance
* Contribute to training material review and localization for BU-specific contexts

**Go-Live & Sustainment**

* Support Parallel Run execution — assist end users in running DILO/MILO cycles using real business cases to validate outcomes
* Participate in BU Readiness Checkpoints and contribute to UAT sign-off documentation
* Provide hypercare support post go-live, acting as the first point of contact for end-user queries and issues
* Document lessons learned, process gaps, and improvement opportunities from testing phases to feed into sustainment planning
* Support the institutionalization of new ways of working and standard operating procedures in the o9 platform

**Demand Analysis Support**

* High data quality management before modelling run – co-work with market planner and stakeholder to set foundation of master data, transaction and driver data.
* Closely working with data scientists to maintain the highest degree of forecast at item and planning accounts level based on industry trends and demand patterns.
* Conduct forecast review and analysis to assess demand trends, measure forecast accuracy, recommend data-driven adjustments.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support product lifecycle milestones, ensuring accurate demand planning for new items.
* Propose and implement forecasting improvements to enhance demand accuracy and efficiency.
* Partner with market planners to review KPIs, gather market insights, and translating market insights into actionable forecast adjustments.
* Monitor and ensure KPI metrics consistently meet business goals.
* Provide weekly performance recaps, including ASE performance reviews, root cause analysis, and action plans aligned with business operations.

No Relocation support available

Headquartered in Singapore, Mondelēz International’s Asia, Middle East and Africa (AMEA) region is comprised of six business units, has more than 21,000 employees and operates in more than 27 countries including Australia, China, Indonesia, Ghana, India, Japan, Malaysia, New Zealand, Nigeria, Philippines, Saudi Arabia, South Africa, Thailand, United Arab Emirates and Vietnam. Seventy-six nationalities work across a network of more than 35 manufacturing plants, three global research and development technical centers and in offices stretching from Auckland, New Zealand to Casablanca, Morocco. description:
**About you:**
**Join us. Unleash your energy within.**
If you have world-class ambitions to reach the stars while keeping your feet on the ground, we’re the team for you. We've created a new breed of company – future-focused with reimagined ambition across all disciplines within the energy sector.

**Our purpose and beliefs:**
As Kent, we’re tackling the greatest challenge of our time - to bring our world the energy it needs in the most responsible way ever imagined.
  
  
It’s the energy of every member of our team driven by our beliefs that is making this happen. Whatever our skill, our language, or our culture. These beliefs define and direct us every day to be the very best - for ourselves, our clients, our key stakeholders, the communities we operate in and the planet:
  
  
We PLAY BIG
  
We thrive on EMOTIONAL AGILITY
  
We are FANATICAL ABOUT PERFORMANCE
  
We are built on INFINITE THINKING
  
  
Read more about the Purpose, Beliefs and Guiding Principles that drive us:
  
  
**Our vision for Diversity, Inclusion and Belonging:**
We recognise that diversity & inclusion are catalysts for success. We’re heightening awareness on the benefits of people diversity, diversity of experiences and diversity of our perspectives. Creating a culture of inclusivity where all employees feel a sense of belonging.  
  
  
Our combined energy is fueled by different nationalities, across 6 continents and 24 countries. Our commitment is to celebrate character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability.
  
  
**Role Purpose**
The Lead Quality Assurance Engineer will lead Program/ Project and execute internal quality audits across Kent's engineering offices and business functions, ensuring compliance with Kent's Quality Management System (QMS), ISO 9001 requirements, applicable industry standards, client requirements and project-specific quality procedures.
  
  
The role will focus on office-based audits of engineering and project execution processes, identifying process gaps, ensuring compliance, driving corrective actions and promoting a culture of quality and continuous improvement across the organisation.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead and conduct planned internal quality audits across engineering offices, projects and corporate support functions.
* Audit engineering, procurement, project management, project controls, document control and other business processes.
* Verify compliance with Kent Management System, ISO 9001:2015 and applicable Oil & Gas industry standards.
* Review project quality plans, procedures, work instructions, technical documentation and quality records.
* Develop audit plans, audit schedules, checklists and audit protocols.
* Identify non-conformities, process deviations, risks and opportunities for improvement.
* Prepare detailed audit reports and communicate findings to relevant department heads and management.
* Coordinate with process owners and stakeholders to establish root causes and implement corrective and preventive actions (CAPA).
* Monitor audit findings and ensure timely and effective closure of corrective actions.
* Support client audits, certification audits and external quality assessments.
* Evaluate the effectiveness of implemented quality processes and recommend improvements.
* Support the implementation, maintenance and continual improvement of the company's QMS.
* Conduct quality awareness sessions and provide guidance to employees on audit requirements and compliance.
* Monitor, review and analyse Key Performance Indicators

  
  
**Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, Civil, Chemical or equivalent).
* 15-20 years of experience in Quality Assurance / Quality Management within the Oil & Gas, EPC, EPCM, Engineering or Construction industry.
* Significant experience in conducting internal audits, process audits and QMS audits.
* ISO 9001:2015 Lead Auditor certification is preferred.
* Good understanding of engineering and project execution processes in Oil & Gas organisations.
* Experience in auditing multidisciplinary engineering and project delivery functions.
* Knowledge of applicable international quality standards and client quality requirements.

  
  
**Required Skills**

* Strong knowledge of Quality Management Systems and ISO 9001 requirements.
* Expertise in internal auditing, process auditing and audit reporting.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving and root cause analysis skills.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to independently lead audits and engage with senior management and functional heads.
* Strong documentation, reporting and presentation skills.
* Ability to drive corrective actions and continuous improvement initiatives.

  
  
**Key Performance Indicators**

* Completion of the approved annual internal audit programme.
* Timely submission of audit reports.
* Effective closure of audit findings and non-conformities.
* Reduction in recurring audit observations.
* Improved compliance with QMS and project quality requirements.
* Effective implementation of corrective and preventive actions.

  
  
**Communication**

* Excellent Oral and written communication skills

  
  
**HSSE**

* The Employee shall observe the Health, Safety, Sustainability, Environment and Quality rules of the company, its clients and the governing authorities of the host country.
* Employee is responsible for adhering to all health and safety procedures, reporting hazardsor incidents promptly and actively participating in maintaining a safe workplace.

  
  
We foster an environment where you are challenged professionally and empowered to take the lead on your career development with the support and guidance of our leaders. We’re committed to making sure that every single person uses their time with us to gain valuable experience and skills for their future, so why not pursue your career with us today!
  
  
**Kent | The Energy Within**

title: Quality Assurance Manager (Python and selenium)
description:
We are looking for a QA Manager to own the QA function across Arcitech’s product portfolio. This is the senior-most QA seat in the organization. You will set QA strategy across products, manage a team of 8 - 12 QA engineers (including the QA Lead who owns hands-on senior QA beneath you), run QA across 7 - 8 concurrent projects, and be the QA counterpart to product and engineering leadership. Reporting directly to the CEO, you are accountable for the release-readiness of everything Arcitech ships.

This is a management role, not primarily a hands-on IC role. You are the strategist, the reviewer, and the leader of the function. Hands-on senior QA designing frameworks, running performance tests, writing critical automation sits with the QA Lead beneath you; your job is to set direction, hold the bar, grow the team, and represent QA at the leadership table. That said, on the hardest technical problems and the highest-risk releases, you will still be hands-on particularly on new-product launches and cross-product testing initiatives. Prior experience running QA at a SaaS / IT product company is non-negotiable. Prior experience genuinely managing a QA team of 8+ is non-negotiable. This is a role for someone who has already done this work before, not someone stepping up into it for the first time.

You will report directly to the CEO.

**Key Responsibilities**

**QA Strategy & Direction**

* Own the QA vision and strategy across the SaaS portfolio.
* Define what gets tested manually, what gets automated, and what needs performance testing per product, per release.
* Own release-readiness decisions in partnership with product and engineering leadership.
* Set priorities across 7-8 concurrent projects; make trade-offs on coverage vs speed explicit.

**Team Management**

* Manage a team of 8-12 QA engineers, including the QA Lead as your direct report.
* Set clear expectations, run 1:1s and reviews, and own performance conversations end-to-end.
* Grow the team’s technical depth in manual, Python + Selenium automation, and performance testing.
* Own hiring for the QA team - who joins, at what level, and how they ramp up.
* Develop the QA Lead specifically as a senior report with their own career growth needs.

**Quality Bar & Review**

* Define and hold the QA quality bar across the whole function.
* Review the QA Lead’s work and the wider team’s work on strategic / high-stakes releases; catch issues before ship.
* Own QA process, documentation, and best practices across the SaaS portfolio.
* Set the standard through your own review - not by out-executing the Lead.

**Cross-Team Leadership & Business Communication**

* Partner with engineering and product leadership on release scope, quality trade-offs, and CI/CD integration.
* Represent QA to the CEO and leadership clearly - what’s shipping, what’s at risk, what needs decisions.
* Communicate quality risks in business terms, not QA jargon - impact, likelihood, mitigation, cost.
* Coordinate with DevOps on CI/CD integration of automated tests across products.

**Hands-On QA (Selective)**

* Personally own the hardest technical problems on high-risk releases when it matters.
* Design or review critical automation frameworks and performance test strategies for new-product launches.
* Delegate day-to-day execution to the Lead and the team - stay in strategy and review mode by default.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* Experience: 6+ years in QA, with at least 3 years in a QA management role
* Team management (must-have, non-negotiable): proven experience managing a QA team of
* 8+, including at least 2+ years directly leading a team - real people-management with 1:1s, reviews, hiring, and performance calls; not just informal mentoring
* SaaS / IT product background (must-have, non-negotiable): prior QA leadership at a technology / SaaS / IT product company
* Manual QA depth (must-have): 6+ years of hands-on manual QA experience - deep, thorough process across test planning, execution, defect management, no shortcuts
* Automation (must-have): 3+ years minimum, hands-on Python + Selenium (not Java). Real frameworks you have built and led teams to build.
* Performance testing (must-have): hands-on with performance / load testing tools (JMeter,
* Locust, K6, or similar); can design, run, analyze
* QA strategy (must-have): genuine experience setting QA direction across multiple products or product lines
* Multi-project (must-have): proven ability to run QA across 7-8 concurrent projects without dropping quality
* CI/CD integration: hands-on with CI/CD integration of QA (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI); driven CI adoption at team level
* Communication: clear, senior communicator; can represent QA to the CEO and cross-functional leadership

**Nice to Have**

* API testing depth (Postman, REST Assured with Python).
* SQL / database validation experience.
* Experience testing AI-driven products or non-deterministic outputs.
* Exposure to security-testing basics.
* Prior experience defining or scaling a QA function from small to mid-size.
* Experience with observability / monitoring integration for post-release quality signal.

**The Ideal Candidate**

* Has genuinely managed a QA team of 8+, and can point to what specifically improved under their leadership.
* Has worked inside a technology / SaaS / IT product company for a meaningful part of their career.
* Is strong across all three testing disciplines — manual, automation, and performance — not just one.
* Can balance strategy, review, team management, and selective hands-on work.
* Communicates well with the CEO and leadership; represents QA as a business function, not a purely technical one.
* Runs a QA function with process and craft, not chaos and heroics.

**Project Role :**
Tech Delivery Subject Matter Expert
  
  
**Project Role Description :**
Drive innovative practices into delivery, bring depth of expertise to a delivery engagement. Sought out as experts, enhance Accentures marketplace reputation. Bring emerging ideas to life by shaping Accenture and client strategy. Use deep technical expertise, business acumen and fluid communication skills, work directly with a client in a trusted advisor relationship to gather requirements to analyze, design and/or implement technology best practice business changes.
  
  
**Must have skills :**
SAP SuccessFactors Variable Pay
  
  
**Good to have skills :**
NA
  
  
**Minimum 7.5 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required**
**Educational Qualification :**
15 years full time education
  
  
Summary:
  
  
As a mid-level expert, you will drive innovative practices into delivery and bring depth of expertise to various engagements. Your typical day will involve leading module configuration activities for SAP Compensation Management & Variable Pay (COMP & VP), ensuring successful delivery within project scope.
  
  
Roles & Responsibilities:-
  
  

* The role is responsible for configuring SuccessFactors modules in line with the approved solution design, executing test data loads, reconciling migrated data, and performing unit testing while logging and resolving defects.
* Responsibilities include updating configuration workbooks, and managing transports and dependencies.
* The role supports end-to-end testing and cutover activities across SIT, UAT, and Production, including data loads & reconciliation (Talent management modules), defect resolution, smoke testing, and scheduling background and integration jobs.
* Post go-live, the role provides enhanced user support, monitors system performance, workflows, integrations, jobs, and reports to ensure business continuity, resolves issues, and completes knowledge transfer and formal handover to AMS support teams.

Professional & Technical Skills:-
  
  
Must to Have Skills: Proficiency in SAP Compensation Management and Variable Pay.
  
  

* Strong understanding of business process design and implementation.
* Independently manage COMP & VP deliverables within a project.
* Act as primary functional contact for assigned module.
* Provide client-facing support during workshops and UAT.
* Mentor junior professionals on configuration and documentation tasks.
* Ability to analyze complex data sets and derive actionable insights.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to engage with stakeholders.

Good to Have Skills:
  
  

* Certification in COMP & VP
* Knowledge in Employee central and PMGM

Additional Information:- The candidate should have minimum 7 years of experience in SAP HCM and SAP Successfactors
  
  

* A 15 years full time education is required.

title: FICO - Consultant - L2
description:
**Position: SAP FICO(S/4HANA) Public Cloud Consultant**
**Relevant Experience : 4- 6 Years**
**Location: Mumbai**
**Notice Period: Immediate to 15 days**
**Key Skills: SAP Grow, CBC (Central Business Configuration), SSCUI Configuration, Fit-to-Standard Methodology.SAP Activate Methodology, Understanding of Public Cloud extensibility concepts, Technical Understanding SAP Fiori Applications, Embedded Analytics, CDS Views (functional awareness),Integration concepts using APIs and SAP BTP, Workflow and Approval Processes. Minimum 1-2 SAP FICO End to End Public Cloud Implementations with Consulting experience**
**Job Description**
The SAP S/4HANA FICO Consultant – L2 will configure, test, implement, and support SAP S/4HANA Finance and Controlling solutions, with experience in SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud. The consultant will work with senior functional leads and customer finance teams to deliver standard, scalable, and business-aligned finance processes.
  
  
This role requires strong hands-on configuration capability, customer interaction skills, and the ability to manage assigned deliverables across implementation phases, including fit-to-standard workshops, realization, testing, go-live, and hypercare.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Support the implementation, rollout, enhancement, and production support of SAP

S/4HANA FICO solutions.
  
  

* Participate in customer workshops, requirement-gathering sessions, fit-to-standard

discussions, system demonstrations, and user training sessions.
  
  

* Analyze finance and controlling business requirements and map them to SAP S/4HANA

**Public Cloud standard processes and SAP Best Practices.**

* Configure and support SAP FICO processes, including:
* General Ledger Accounting
* Accounts Payable
* Accounts Receivable
* Asset Accounting
* Bank Accounting and payment processes
* Tax configuration
* Financial closing activities
* Cost Center Accounting
* Profit Center Accounting
* Internal Orders
* Configure and maintain finance organizational structures, chart of accounts, fiscal year

variants, posting periods, document types, payment terms, tolerance groups, and other
  
  
relevant settings.
  
  

* Support integration testing between FICO and other modules, including MM, SD, PP,

EWM, and third-party applications.
  
  

* Assist with finance master data and transactional data migration, validation,

reconciliation, mock conversions, and cutover preparation.
  
  

* Create functional specifications for reports, forms, workflows, interfaces, and approved

extensions under the guidance of the FICO Lead.
  
  

* Execute unit testing, support system integration testing and UAT, analyze defects, and

coordinate resolution with relevant teams.
  
  

* Support go-live, hypercare, and post-go-live incident resolution for finance and

controlling processes.
  
  

* Prepare and maintain configuration documents, business process documents, test

scripts, training materials, user guides, and issue logs.
  
  

* Provide functional support to business users and guide them on SAP Fiori applications

and standard S/4HANA processes.
  
  

* Work closely with project managers, FICO leads, technical consultants, integration

teams, data migration teams, and client stakeholders.
  
  

* Follow SAP Activate methodology, project governance, documentation standards, and

clean-core principles.
  
  
**Required Skills And Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration,

related discipline.
  
  

* 4–6 years of relevant SAP consulting experience in SAP Finance and Controlling.
* Strong functional knowledge and hands-on configuration experience in SAP S/4HANA

FICO.
  
  

* At least one end-to-end SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud implementation experience.
* Experience with SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud fit-to-standard workshops, SAP Best

Practices, scope items, and standard configuration processes.
  
  

* Functional expertise in key FICO areas such as GL, AP, AR, Asset Accounting, tax, bank

accounting, Cost Center Accounting, Profit Center Accounting, and Internal Orders.
  
  

* Knowledge of finance integration points with SAP MM, SD, PP, and other relevant SAP

modules.
  
  

* Experience with finance data migration, reconciliation, testing, defect tracking, and

cutover support.
  
  

* Familiarity with SAP Fiori applications and embedded reporting relevant to finance

users.
  
  

* Understanding of SAP Activate project methodology and implementation lifecycle

activities.
  
  

* Ability to write clear functional specifications, test scenarios, and process

documentation.
  
  

* Strong customer-facing, communication, collaboration, and delivery capabilities.
* Ability to manage assigned tasks independently and escalate risks, dependencies, and

complex issues proactively.
  
  

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

**Preferred Skills**

* SAP certification in SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition Finance.
* Experience with SAP Central Business Configuration (CBC).
* Knowledge of SAP Group Reporting, SAP Analytics Cloud, SAP Ariba, Treasury, or

Advanced Financial Closing.
  
  

* Exposure to global finance transformation, multi-company, or multi-country

implementation environments.
  
  

* Understanding of IFRS, statutory reporting, local taxation, and audit controls.
* Experience working in Agile or hybrid project delivery models.

**Key Competencies**

* Hands-on SAP S/4HANA FICO configuration and support capability.
* Strong understanding of finance business processes and controls.
* Customer-oriented approach with confident communication skills.
* Ability to work effectively with both business users and technical teams.
* Commitment to standardization, fit-to-standard adoption, and clean-core principles.
* Attention to detail in financial data, system configuration, testing, and reconciliation.
* Ability to deliver high-quality work within defined timelines and project governance

requirements.
  
  
**Key Performance Indicators**

* Timely completion of assigned FICO configuration, testing, documentation, and support

deliverables.
  
  

* Quality of finance process design, configuration, and test outcomes.
* Successful participation in fit-to-standard workshops, testing cycles, data migration,

cutover, and go-live activities.
  
  

* Timely identification and resolution of functional defects and production issues.
* Positive customer and stakeholder feedback.
* Compliance with project methodology, documentation standards, and SAP S/4HANA

Public Cloud best practices.

title: SAP Event Management (EM) Consultant
description:
**Job Summary**
We are looking for an experienced SAP Event Management (EM) Consultant with 3–5 years of hands-on experience in SAP EM configuration, implementation, and integration with SAP Transportation Management (TM), SAP ECC, and SAP S/4HANA. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in supply chain visibility, event tracking, milestone monitoring, and exception handling.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Solution Design & Configuration: Configure expected and unexpected events, event handlers, and rule sets within SAP Event Management (SAP EM) in integration with SAP TM and SAP ECC.
* System Integration: Integrate SAP EM with SAP S/4HANA, SAP Transportation Management (TM), and SAP ECC using IDocs, RFCs, BAPIs, and SAP BTP.
* Event & Milestone Tracking: Monitor end-to-end transportation processes and track real-time operational events against predefined milestones and benchmarks.
* Exception Management: Identify, monitor, and resolve unexpected events, delays, and transportation exceptions.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with supply chain, logistics, and technical teams to improve transportation visibility and operational efficiency.
* Reporting: Utilize standard SAP EM reporting tools to provide event tracking, milestone status, and exception reports.
* Testing & Support: Prepare functional specifications, execute test cases, troubleshoot integration and interface issues, and provide production and go-live support.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**
  
  

* 3–5 years of hands-on experience in SAP Event Management (SAP EM).
* Strong knowledge of SAP EM configuration, event handlers, expected events, unexpected events, and rule sets.
* Experience integrating SAP EM with SAP TM, SAP ECC, and SAP S/4HANA.
* Good understanding of SAP integration technologies, including:

+ IDocs
+ RFCs
+ BAPIs
+ SAP BTP

* Strong understanding of supply chain visibility and transportation processes.
* Experience in milestone tracking, event monitoring, and exception handling.
* Ability to prepare functional specifications and support testing activities.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience in SAP TM and logistics execution processes.
* Exposure to end-to-end transportation lifecycle management.
* Knowledge of SAP S/4HANA integration and implementation projects.
* Experience in SAP EM production support and go-live activities.

title: Health Informatics Analyst
description:
**Health Informatics Analyst (AI Training)**
**About The Role**
We're looking for experienced Health Informatics Analysts to help evaluate and improve AI systems being developed for healthcare applications. Your clinical data expertise will directly shape how AI understands, interprets, and reasons about health information — making a real impact on the future of healthcare technology.
  
  
At Alignerr, we partner with the world's leading AI research teams and labs to build and train cutting-edge AI models. This is a unique opportunity to apply your health informatics background to one of the most transformative technology fields of our time.
  
  

* Organization: Alignerr
* Type: Hourly Contract
* Location: Remote
* Commitment: 10–40 hours/week

**What You'll Do**

* Analyze and interpret healthcare and EHR data to identify trends, gaps, and opportunities for improvement
* Evaluate AI-generated outputs related to clinical workflows, health information systems, and medical data pipelines for accuracy and quality
* Assess the performance of health information systems and provide structured, expert feedback
* Prepare clear recommendations and evaluations that help AI systems better understand clinical and operational healthcare contexts
* Collaborate asynchronously with a global team of healthcare and AI professionals
* Work independently on task-based assignments on your own schedule

**Who You Are**

* Hands-on experience with healthcare data, EHR systems, or clinical reporting platforms
* Strong analytical skills including data visualization, reporting, and trend analysis
* Ability to communicate complex healthcare data concepts clearly in writing
* Comfortable evaluating information quality and providing structured, detailed feedback
* Self-motivated and reliable with strong attention to detail

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with data annotation, data quality assurance, or evaluation workflows
* Familiarity with health information standards such as HL7, FHIR, or ICD coding
* Background in clinical informatics, public health, or health IT consulting
* Prior exposure to AI or machine learning projects in healthcare settings

**Why Join Us**

* Work on cutting-edge AI projects with top research labs shaping the future of healthcare AI
* Fully remote and flexible — work on your own schedule from anywhere
* Freelance perks: autonomy, variety, and global collaboration
* Contribute to meaningful work that improves how AI serves clinicians and patients
* Potential for ongoing work and contract extension

**Company Description**
GMP Technical Solutions is a global turnkey MEP and Integrated Building Management Systems (IBMS) provider with a leading market presence in the pharmaceutical industry. The company delivers end-to-end design and build solutions for complex clean room and engineering projects, supported by a team of over 500 multidisciplinary in-house engineers. GMP operates state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities in Baddi, Bhiwandi, and Chunni Kalan, producing a wide range of clean room variants and related equipment such as laminar airflow units, biosafety cabinets, pass boxes, isolators, and containment solutions. With offices across major Indian cities, GMP is positioned for strong growth in clean room solutions, turnkey MEP, IBMS, fire alarm and hydrant systems, CCTV surveillance, and IT and networking.
  
**Role Description**
The Senior Quality Engineer – MEP is a full-time, on-site role based in Navi Mumbai. Day-to-day activities include developing and implementing quality plans, conducting inspections and audits, reviewing technical documentation and drawings, and collaborating with design, project, and manufacturing teams to resolve quality issues. The Senior Quality Engineer will monitor product and installation quality, analyze data to identify trends, recommend corrective and preventive actions, and support continuous improvement initiatives. The role also involves preparing quality reports, guiding junior team members, and coordinating with clients and stakeholders to address quality-related requirements and feedback.

* Candidates should possess strong Quality Engineering and Quality Management skills to design, implement, and improve MEP quality frameworks.

* Candidates should possess Product Quality expertise to ensure delivered systems and components meet performance, safety, and regulatory standards.
* Relevant experience in MEP projects, clean room or pharmaceutical facilities, and knowledge of applicable codes and standards.
* Ability to interpret technical drawings, specifications, and quality documentation, with strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
* Effective communication and collaboration skills to work with cross-functional teams and external stakeholders.
* Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Electrical, or related Engineering discipline; advanced certifications in quality (e.g., Six Sigma, ISO standards) are an advantage.
* Proven experience in a senior or lead quality role within construction, engineering, or manufacturing environments.

title: Consultant, ESI Processing and Data Transformation l Technology
description:
**Who We Are**
FTI Consulting is the leading global expert firm for organizations facing crisis and transformation. We work with many of the world’s top multinational corporations, law firms, banks and private equity firms on their most important issues to deliver impact that makes a difference. From resolving disputes, navigating crises, managing risk and optimizing performance, our teams respond rapidly to dynamic and complex situations.
  
  
At FTI Consulting, you’ll work side-by side with leaders who have shaped history, helping solve the biggest challenges making headlines today. From day one, you’ll be an integral part of a focused team where you can make a real impact. You’ll be surrounded by an open, collaborative culture that embraces diversity, recognition, professional development and, most importantly, you.
  
  
Are you ready to make your impact?
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking a Consultant / Senior Consultant to join our Data Engineering team. The role supports eDiscovery and data investigation engagements through data processing, transformation, analysis, troubleshooting and production support. The successful candidate will apply strong SQL skills, working knowledge of eDiscovery workflows and practical scripting capabilities to deliver accurate, timely results in collaboration with local and global teams.
  
  

* Work flexibly across projects, shifting priorities and deadlines; participate in global team coverage and, when required, evening, night, weekend or holiday work based on project needs.
* Be willing to travel for client or business requirements, generally with advance notice.
* Maintain responsiveness, professionalism, confidentiality and a client-service mindset in interactions with internal and external stakeholders.
* Take ownership of assigned work, communicate progress and risks promptly, and learn new tools, data sources and processes as engagement needs evolve.

**What You’ll Do**

* Perform data intake, processing, extraction, conversion, transformation, analysis, loading, export and production support for eDiscovery and data investigation matters.
* Map, cleanse, normalize and reconcile metadata; resolve issues involving identifiers, document families, date/time values, character encoding and inconsistent source data.
* Prepare, validate and troubleshoot eDiscovery load files and related native, text and image deliverables; perform documented quality-control checks for accuracy, completeness and integrity.
* Investigate processing exceptions and technical issues, recommend practical solutions and escalate risks or dependencies appropriately.
* Coordinate with case teams and stakeholders to clarify requirements, provide timely updates, manage assigned deliverables and document procedures, scripts and resolutions.
* Identify opportunities to standardize or automate repetitive workflows and improve quality and efficiency.

**How You’ll Grow**
We are committed to investing and supporting you in your professional development and we have developed a range of programs focused on fostering leadership, growth and development opportunities. We aim to promote continuous learning and individual skills development through on-the-job learning, self-guided professional development courses and certifications. You’ll be assigned a dedicated coach to mentor, guide and support you through regular coaching sessions and serve as an advocate for your professional growth.
  
  
As you progress through your career at FTI Consulting, we offer tailored programs for critical professional milestones to ensure you are prepared and empowered to take on your next role.
  
  
**What You Will Need to Succeed**
Basic Qualifications
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant practical experience. Consultant: typically 2+ years of relevant experience in eDiscovery, data processing, data transformation or comparable technical data operations.
* Senior Consultant: typically 3–5+ years of relevant experience, including independent delivery of complex technical tasks, troubleshooting and coordination with project teams.
* Preferred, not mandatory: familiarity with EDRM; Nuix or other review/processing platforms; Microsoft 365, Teams, Slack, SharePoint, OneDrive, Google Workspace or mobile extraction data; large-volume SQL optimization; PowerShell, pandas/openpyxl, regular expressions or Relativity APIs; and consulting or litigation support experience.
* Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail and a methodical approach to troubleshooting and quality control.
* Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain technical findings to non-technical colleagues and stakeholders.
* Ability to organize and prioritize multiple tasks, follow documented processes, work independently within assigned scope and collaborate across teams.
* Initiative, adaptability and willingness to learn unfamiliar tools, workflows and digital data sources.

Preferred Qualifications
  
  

* Strong working proficiency in Microsoft SQL Server / T-SQL for data manipulation, joins, complex queries, scripts, stored procedures and troubleshooting.
* Working knowledge of eDiscovery workflows and platforms such as Relativity, including imports/exports, metadata management, review support and productions.
* Ability to work with common eDiscovery load files (DAT, OPT, CSV) and structured or semi-structured formats such as Excel, JSON and XML.
* Basic Python scripting skills for file handling, ad-hoc data processing and automation; ability to adapt and troubleshoot existing scripts.
* Comfort with Microsoft Windows and Office tools, especially Excel, for day-to-day technical operations and validation.

description:
**Job Description**
**Are You Ready to Make It Happen at Mondelēz International?**
**Join our Mission to Lead the Future of Snacking. Make It Possible.**
**Purpose of the Role**
The Supply Planning SME will serve as the BU's dedicated testing and adoption resource for the O9 Supply Planning module. Reporting into the region SP transformation lead, this role is responsible for executing test scripts, validating data integrity, supporting training delivery, and ensuring seamless transition from testing to go-live. The SME will act as the first line of support for end users, bridging the gap between the technical implementation team and the business, and championing user confidence and adoption of the new platform.
  
  
**Main Responsibilities**
**Modelling Constraints & Validation:**
Lead Plan Quality Validation phase for multiple business units across region.
  
  
Work with Business stakeholders to gather the manufacturing constraints and model these constraints in O9.
  
  
Work with system integration partner and perform solver execution, perform RCA , analyse KPI , perform checklist against business requirements and flag issues to partner team.
  
  
Solve Solver related problems with consideration of sustainable and standardized solution representing AMEA.
  
  
Responsible for planning functional build & implementation/Working in testing and processes validation
  
  
Document Functional requirements / participate in fit gap analyses with regional functional stream lead
  
  
**Testing & Validation**

* Execute Integration Test (iTest) and UAT test scripts end-to-end for Supply Planning processes, ensuring 100% script coverage as per the test strategy
* Validate pre-load and post-load data accuracy during User Cutover Testing (UCUT), flagging discrepancies and coordinating resolution with the data and cutover teams
* Perform security role validation — test user access, roles, and permissions ahead of each testing phase
* Log, track, and follow up on defects in qTest/Jira, ensuring timely resolution within SLA and supporting retesting of failed test cases
* Execute E2E (End-to-End) scenario testing including cross-stream scenarios with Data Science, Supply Planning, and IBP
* Support pre-test preparation including batch job readiness, test script pre-requisites documentation, and environment checks
* Participate in daily testing war rooms, morning kick-offs, and end-of-day recaps to report progress, blockers, and pass rates

**Training & Change Adoption**

* Support the delivery of Pre-UAT and UAT training sessions for BU end users, including o9 system basics, Day-in-the-Life (DILO) walkthroughs, and advanced SP system training
* Conduct shadow testing sessions — walk end users through test scripts and o9 navigation to build familiarity and confidence
* Act as a go-to resource for end users during testing phases, providing real-time guidance on o9 processes and ways of working
* Support the BU Champion in driving change management activities, user communications, and adoption governance
* Contribute to training material review and localization for BU-specific contexts

**Go-Live & Sustainment**

* Support Parallel Run execution — assist end users in running DILO/MILO cycles using real business cases to validate outcomes
* Participate in BU Readiness Checkpoints and contribute to UAT sign-off documentation
* Provide hyper care support post go-live, acting as the first point of contact for end-user queries and issues
* Document lessons learned, process gaps, and improvement opportunities from testing phases to feed into sustainment planning
* Support the institutionalization of new ways of working and standard operating procedures in the o9 platform

**Functional Support**

* Develop working-level expertise in the o9 Supply Planning module, including Master Production Scheduling, Distribution Planning, Truck Load Build.
* Support the BU Champion in fit-gap analysis, functional requirement documentation, and process design validation
* Participate in co-location events, workshops, and cross-functional design sessions as required
* Represent BU-specific scenarios and edge cases during testing to ensure comprehensive coverage

**More About This Role**

* Solid understanding of Supply Planning processes (Master Production Scheduling, Distribution Planning, Truck Load Build.
* 3–8 years of experience in Supply Chain Planning or a related operational role
* Familiarity with planning tools/systems; exposure to advanced planning solutions (o9, Kinaxis, OMP, SAP IBP) is a necessity.
* Strong attention to detail — ability to execute test scripts methodically and identify data discrepancies
* Comfortable working with testing tools (qTest, Jira) and documenting test results and defects
* Good communication skills — ability to train and support peers in a clear, structured manner
* Collaborative mindset with ability to work in cross-functional, multi-market teams under tight timelines
* Growth mindset, quick learner, and comfortable navigating ambiguity in a fast-paced transformation environment
* Proficiency in English; additional regional language skills are a plus

**Educational Qualification:**
MBA (Operations/Supply Chain Management)/ Bachelors degree in Engineering/ Supply chain management /Business Analytics/ Statistics or related field

title: Connectors Engineer (Mid / Senior / Lead)
description:
**Role Title:**
Connectors Engineer (Mid / Senior / Lead)

**Department:**
Product Engineering

**Location:**
Mumbai / Pune (Onsite)

**Reports To:**
Engineering Manager

**Experience:**
5+ years, hiring across levels. Level is set by what you can own end to end, not by years on a resume.

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**About Scitara:**
Scitara is a global leader in digital transformation for scientific laboratories, enabling connectivity, automation, and data integrity across instruments, applications, and enterprise systems. Our cloud-based DLX platform is used by the world's top pharma, biotech, life sciences, and industrial R&D labs to modernize workflows and accelerate scientific outcomes. Lab informatics is growing 50 to 70% over the next five years, at the exact moment AI is being layered onto scientific data workflows. None of that works until the data gets off the instrument. That is what connectors do.

**Role Summary:**
Connectors are how DLX reaches into the lab: chromatography systems, balances, plate readers, LIMS, ELNs, and vendor applications that were never designed to talk to anything. They are C#/.NET Windows services running on lab PCs, with no web stack. Each one is its own small project with its own surprises: a vendor SDK, a COM or OLE interface, a serial protocol, a file drop, a database nobody documented. Because there are dozens of these projects and each one is different, this role is for a generalist who is comfortable being handed an unfamiliar system and working out how to make it reliable. A specialty in one integration style is welcome on top of that, but it will be useful on one project in fifty, so it cannot be the whole story.

**How Engineering Works Here:**

We are a small team with a large product. That shapes everything:

**You deliver features, not tickets**
. You get a target system and a goal. You work out how to talk to it, what the data looks like, how to make it reliable, and how to prove it. Nobody hands you a task list.

**AI is part of the job.**
We use agentic coding tools every day to design, generate, test, and document. You are expected to work this way and to be a sharp reviewer of what the tools produce. You own the result, not the tool.

**We are regulated.**
Connectors run inside validated GxP labs. Data integrity, traceability, and auditability are design constraints, not a checklist at the end.

**Thinkers and doers.**
The people who do well here notice problems, propose fixes, get them wrong sometimes, and get them right the next time. They bring ideas back to the team instead of waiting to be told.

**Key Outcomes (First 6 to 12 Months):**
Deliver complete connectors into customer labs: discovery, design, implementation, tests, validation evidence, documentation. Take a target system from "here is the vendor" to a working plan without waiting for a task breakdown. Improve the shared connector framework and tooling so the next connector is faster than the last. Use AI tooling to cut the time from vendor documentation (or its absence) to working code. Senior / Lead: own the connector architecture and set the bar for the engineers around you.

**Responsibilities:**
Responsibilities Design and build connectors as C#/.NET Windows services that integrate instruments and lab systems with the DLX platform. Work with whatever the target exposes: REST, vendor SDKs, COM/OLE, file systems, databases, serial and network protocols. Build for environments you do not control: locked-down lab PCs, restricted networks, machines you cannot restart at will. Write code that meets data integrity and validation requirements. Use agentic development tools as the default way of working, and review their output critically. Troubleshoot integration issues in customer environments using structured problem-solving. Participate in design reviews, code reviews, and Agile ceremonies as a contributor, not an attendee. Senior / Lead: lead spikes on new integration approaches; mentor and raise engineering standards.

**Must-Have:**
Strong C# and .NET, including long-running services (Windows Services or equivalent), not just web applications. You have integrated with systems you did not build and could not change, and made those integrations reliable. Comfortable starting from incomplete or missing documentation and working out how a system behaves. Daily, hands-on use of AI coding tools, and the judgement to know when they are wrong. A track record of delivering work you were given as goals, not as task lists. Solid engineering fundamentals: design, testing, debugging. Git and CI/CD in a team setting.

**Good-to-Have:**
COM/OLE, Windows API, instrument protocols (serial, GPIB, TCP/IP), or file-based integrations. Lab informatics or scientific instruments: LIMS, ELN, CDS, chromatography, analytical instruments. Regulated software: GxP, GAMP 5, 21 CFR Part 11, data integrity. Messaging systems (Kafka, RabbitMQ) and distributed or event-driven design. Exposure to the platform side: Node.js/TypeScript, cloud services, AWS. Building AI agents or working with MCP servers.

**Success Indicators:**
Connectors reach customer labs without needing the plan written for you. Each connector you deliver makes the next one easier. Your use of AI tooling makes you faster and your work more thorough, and your peers pick up what you learn. Colleagues in product, quality, services, and the platform team trust your judgement. Senior / Lead: connector decisions get made well when the architect is not in the room.

**Why Join Scitara?**
Get real instruments talking to real science for the labs developing the next generation of therapies. Variety: every connector is a new system and a new problem. Work in an engineering culture where AI-native development is the default, not an experiment. Real ownership: designs and decisions are yours. Clear paths into technical leadership and architecture.

title: Quality Engineer AI First
description:
Quality Engineer (AI-first Testing)

About the role

You will be the first AI-first quality engineer at Verdantis, testing an AI-native platform MRO360 and our MDM product that large plants in energy, manufacturing and mining use to run their spare parts, equipment and material master data. The product makes decisions, not just screens: it recommends stock levels, flags duplicate materials and classifies parts. Testing means testing both the software and the judgement.

We do not want a manual tester with a 400-row spreadsheet, nor a classic automation engineer maintaining brittle scripts. We want someone early in their career who already uses AI to generate test cases, write and repair automation, explore edge cases and read logs and who wants to find out how far that can go. You will set the pattern for how quality is done here.

What you do

**Functional testing**

* Own test coverage for new features across MRO360 and MDM: read the story, generate the test cases with AI, prune and sharpen them yourself, and execute them before the sprint closes.
* Test the AI behavior, not just the UI: build evaluation sets for recommendations (stock levels, duplicate detection, classification), define what "correct" means with the product manager and data scientists, and track accuracy release over release.
* Reproduce customer-reported defects with real-shaped data (SAP material master, equipment, BOM extracts), write them up so a developer can fix them in one pass, and verify the fix.

**Platform testing**

* Build and maintain automated regression suites (API and UI) written with AI, reviewed and owned by you that run on every build.
* Run integration tests against SAP-style data flows: flat-file loads, OData/IDoc payloads, error handling, idempotency on re-runs.
* Test what enterprise customers' security and IT teams will ask about: role-based access, multi-tenant data isolation, performance at 200K+ SKUs, audit logs.

**Raising the bar**

* Keep a living record of which AI tools and prompts work for which testing tasks and share it with engineering, so test generation becomes part of how developers work.
* Report release readiness in one page the Engineering Lead and the Delivery Head can act on: what was tested, what was not, what is risky.
* Push back on shipping when the evidence says no.

What we are looking for

* 1-3 years in software testing or development, or a strong fresher with projects that show it. Attitude and tooling fluency matter more than years.
* Uses AI tools daily and can show it: a test suite generated and refined with an LLM, an automation script debugged with Copilot or Claude, a prompt library built for test design. We will ask for a live demonstration.
* Can write code: Python or JavaScript/TypeScript well enough to build and repair automation (Playwright, Selenium, pytest, Postman/REST clients) without waiting for a developer.
* Knows the basics of good testing: boundary cases, equivalence classes, negative paths, test data design and can explain why an AI-generated test case is weak.
* Comfortable with SQL for checking data loads and results against the database.
* Curious about the domain: willing to learn what a material master, a reorder point or an equipment BOM is, because the bugs that matter are domain bugs.
* Writes a clear defect report and a clear release note. Argues with evidence, not opinion.
* Based in or willing to relocate to Mumbai.

Nice to have

* Exposure to testing LLM-based features: prompt regression, evaluation datasets, hallucination and consistency checks.
* Experience with CI pipelines (GitHub Actions or similar) and running tests in them.
* Basic understanding of cloud deployments and multi-tenant SaaS.
* Any exposure to SAP, EAM or supply chain software is useful, not required.
* Performance or load testing with k6, JMeter or Locust.

Who this role is not for

* Someone who wants a test plan handed to them and executes it line by line.
* Someone who sees AI as a shortcut to avoid understanding the product. The tool generates; you are accountable.
* Someone who wants to stay in one layer. This role spans UI, API, data and model behaviour.
* Someone who is uncomfortable telling a senior developer their feature is not ready.

* Must have completed multiple SAP projects and have excellent communication skills

* Proven expedience large stream of work across multiple locations

* Strong hands-on experience on FI-CA concepts:

+ Incoming Payments (Real Time, Direct Debit, Cash Desk, etc)
+ Outgoing Payments and Returns
+ Collection process using Collection Strategy

+ Transfer Posting process
+ Escheatment process

* Strong knowledge of month-end and period-end closing and FICA to FICO GL integration.
* Implementation experience of BRF Plus.
* Experience and knowledge of using middleware technology to integrate SAP with third party systems for payments, collection agencies, etc
* Experience in data migration.
* Can work under minimum supervision, good time management and work planning

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* College degree in related technology field (Computer, Engineering, Science, etc) or comparable job experiences
* Approximately 5 to 8 years of experience in a functional role. Able to exhibit a progression of increasingly complex job responsibilities during the period
* Prior SAP BRIM CI role is a must
* Should have worked on minimum 1 implementation from scratch as a lead consultant.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Experience on integration with third-party applications
* Knowledge of integration with SAP RAR, BRIM CI/SOM/CM
* Hands on experience in SAP S4 HANA Platform
* Experience on tools like JIRA or equivalent tool to maintain stories.

* Certification in SAP FICA (IUT240 / AC240 / BR240)
* Certifications in SAP BRIM Convergent Invoicing (AC245 / BR245)

**Technologies and Tools**

* SAP FI-CA / FI-CAX
* SAP FIORI
* Jira or similar tools
* Azure DevOps or similar tools

* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience, and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
* An opportunity to be a part of market-leading, multi-disciplinary team in the integrated global transaction business worldwide.
* Opportunities to work with EY Utilities practices globally with leading businesses across a range of geographies

**What We Offer**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.

* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.

title: Sr Mgr Quality Assurance- On Site CMO Manager
description:
**We Are Teva**
We’re Teva, a leading innovative biopharmaceutical company, enabled by a world-class generics business. Whether it’s innovating in the fields of neuroscience and immunology or delivering high-quality medicine worldwide, we’re dedicated to addressing patients’ needs now and in the future. Here, you will be part of a high-performing, inclusive culture that values fresh thinking and collaboration. You'll have the room to grow, the flexibility to balance life with work, and the opportunity to better health worldwide, together.
  
  
**Our Team, Your Impact**
The On-site CMO Manager – ExM Quality serves as the Quality lead located at assigned Contract Manufacturing Organizations (CMOs) and key suppliers, ensuring compliant manufacturing, release, and supply of Teva products across global markets. The role provides end-to-end quality oversight, risk management, and QMS governance for external manufacturing operations, ensuring adherence to cGMP requirements, regulatory expectations, Teva quality standards, and Quality Technical Agreements while supporting uninterrupted product supply
  
  
**How You’ll Spend Your Day**

* Pharmaceutical QMS (Deviations, CAPA, Change Control, Investigations, APR/PQR, Validation, SOPs).
* CMO/Supplier Quality Management and cGMP compliance oversight.
* Global regulatory requirements (USFDA, EMA, Health Canada, and international markets).
* Product transfers, commercialization, process changes, and lifecycle management.
* Quality risk management, NTM/GNTM, complaint handling, and escalation management.
* Regulatory inspections, customer audits, and health authority interactions.
* Quality Technical Agreements (QTA) and supplier qualification programs.
* Quality KPIs, audit CAPAs, stability programs, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Cross-functional stakeholder management and leadership communication.
* External Manufacturing (ExM) quality oversight.
* Should also possess basic knowledge in Supply Chain, Regulatory Affairs, and MS&T processes.

Long Description
  
  
Shop Floor Quality Oversight
  
  

* Serve as Teva's on-site quality representative, maintaining a strong quality presence across CMO site operations.
* Participate in daily production and operational review meetings to provide quality oversight and ensure alignment with production objectives.
* Monitor adherence to cGMP requirements, approved procedures, and quality standards through routine shop floor engagement.
* Provide real-time visibility and escalation of critical quality events, deviations, compliance concerns, and operational risks.

Manufacturing Operations Monitoring
  
  

* Provide continuous oversight of manufacturing activities to ensure uninterrupted execution of production plans and supply commitments.
* Monitor production schedules, batch progression, and operational performance to identify potential delays, bottlenecks, and execution risks.
* Maintain visibility of equipment downtime, resource constraints, and operational challenges that may impact product quality or supply continuity.
* Escalate emerging risks and critical issues to relevant Teva stakeholders in a timely manner to support proactive decision-making and issue resolution.

Investigation, Quality Systems & Execution Support
  
  

* Support and provide effective challenges during investigations to ensure robust root cause identification and sustainable corrective actions.
* Monitor investigation progress and ensure timely closure of deviations, CAPAs, and quality actions.
* Verify implementation and effectiveness of corrective and preventive actions to drive continuous compliance improvement.
* Partner with site quality and operations teams to facilitate timely batch documentation review, record closure, and release readiness activities.

Operational Excellence & Continuous Improvement
  
  

* Drive and support site-level quality, compliance, and operational excellence initiatives.
* Partner with cross-functional teams to identify opportunities for process improvement, simplification, and performance enhancement.
* Support Lean and Operational Excellence programs to improve efficiency, compliance, and manufacturing reliability.
* Provide independent assessments and insights on site performance, quality culture, and operational effectiveness through regular reporting and governance forums.

Risk Management & Stakeholder Engagement
  
  

* Proactively identify, assess, and escalate quality, compliance, operational, and supply risks to ensure timely mitigation and resolution.
* Act as the primary on-site liaison between the CMO and Teva's External Manufacturing (ExM) Quality organization.
* Provide timely and actionable reporting to ExM Quality Leadership and relevant Teva functions to enable informed decision-making and rapid issue resolution.
* Facilitate effective communication, collaboration, and alignment between site personnel and Teva stakeholders to support business and quality objectives.

**Your Skills And Experience**

* Bachelor’s/master’s degree in Pharmacy, Chemistry, or related field.
* 12+ years of experience in pharmaceutical quality assurance, with strong exposure to CMO management.
* Experience in Quality Management Systems and CMO oversight.
* Proficient in TrackWise, Veeva, regulatory compliance, and audit management.

**How We’ll Take Care Of You**
At Teva India, care is at the heart of how we work. From your first day, you’ll be welcomed into a people-first culture built on inclusion, respect, and belonging.
  
  
That support extends to you and your loved ones through benefits designed for real life. These include comprehensive medical insurance, OPD coverage, annual health checkups, term life and accident insurance, and confidential emotional wellbeing support through our Optum Employee Assistance Program. You’ll also enjoy healthy meals at work, holistic wellbeing initiatives, and volunteering programs that help you give back to the community.
  
  
Your growth matters too. You’ll have opportunities to build future-ready skills, collaborate on projects with global teams, explore internal career opportunities, and learn through programs such as our AI-enabled Teva Twist program, R&D Academy, continuing education, and mentorship.
  
  
Join our vibrant workplace, where we celebrate milestones, festivals, achievements, and community impact together.
  
  
**Already Working @Teva?**
Make sure to apply through our internal career site on Twist—your one-stop shop for career development
  
  
**Teva’s Equal Employment Opportunity Commitment**
Teva Pharmaceuticals is committed to equal opportunity in employment. It is Teva's global policy that equal employment opportunity be provided without regard to age, race, creed, color, religion, sex, disability, pregnancy, medical condition, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, ancestry, veteran status, national or ethnic origin or any other legally recognized status entitled to protection under applicable laws. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace for all. If you are contacted for a job opportunity, please advise us of any accommodations needed to support you throughout the recruitment and selection process. All accommodation information provided will be treated as confidential and used only for the purpose of providing an accessible candidate experience.

title: Software Solutions Engineer I-Billing
description:
TITLE

* Leverage Duck Creek upgrade tools to generate differential analysis and produce low-impact upgrade paths for Duck Creek customers.

* Apply strong product implementation knowledge and technical expertise to effectively support product upgrade and certification processes

* Identify opportunities to automate processes or develop utilities that assist in faster and more effective upgrades.
* Interacts with customer counterparts to triage issues and present solutions.

* Perform all other duties and activities as required.
* Act in accordance with and as a good steward of Duck Creek Technologies mission, vision, and core values:

+ Mission: To empower insurers to reimagine the future of insurance
+ Vision: To transform insurance technology, helping insurers be smarter, faster, and more efficient, and ultimately provide the best protection for people and businesses
+ Values: We Prioritize Respect, We Listen, We Care, We Add Value, and We Lead

**What You’ve Done**
Education and Work Experience:
  
  


* Bachelor’s degree, or higher educational level, or foreign equivalent, in Computer Science strongly preferred

* Demonstrated proficiency in Analysis, Development, and Triage.
* Demonstrated proficiency and implementation experience in any of the Duck Creek Billing Product
* Basic understanding of Duck Creek Billing concepts such as billing forms, billing plans, payment plans, Direct Bill, Agency Bill, EFT/payment processing, and billing transactions
* Hands-on development experience with C#, .NET, SQL Server, XML/XSLT, REST/SOAP APIs, and Duck Creek extensibility/configuration
* Experience with SQL query development, stored procedures, database troubleshooting, and performance optimization
* Has developed foundational insurance domain knowledge and can apply it to support project delivery and problem-solving.

**Skills, Knowledge, Abilities, And Behaviors**

* Knowledge of insurance products a plus
* Experience/knowledge of P&C Insurance software applications a plus
* Experience/knowledge of software development life cycle for P&C insurance software a plus
* Good to have knowledge in TFS, GitHub and GIT workflow.
* Good analytical and problem-solving skills
* Good communication skills, verbal and written.
* Experience in Duck Creek Billing upgrades/certifications and assessing customizations, integrations, and compatibility

CORE COMPETENCIES
  
  
Our team is built on strong core values that guide how we work and grow together. We prioritize clear and thoughtful communication, fostering open collaboration across diverse perspectives to achieve shared goals. We approach challenges with curiosity and critical thinking, seeking creative solutions while remaining adaptable in a fast-changing environment. We take accountability for our work and outcomes, holding ourselves to high standards of integrity and professionalism. Above all, we are committed to doing the right thing—treating others with respect, embracing continuous learning, and engaging inclusively across cultures and backgrounds.
  
  
LEARN MORE
  
  

* Company Website – Transforming Insurance with Duck Creek's SaaS Solutions
* Life at Duck Creek – Life at Duck Creek - Duck Creek

**Experience:**

**Department:**

**Job Summary**

We are seeking a detail-oriented and proactive In-Process Inspection Engineer to ensure product quality throughout the manufacturing process. The role involves in-process inspections, rejection and rework analysis, customer complaint handling, process compliance monitoring, and coordination with Production, Maintenance, and Quality teams to achieve zero-defect manufacturing.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**In-Process Quality Control**

* Conduct on-time First Piece and Last Piece approvals.
* Monitor and inspect parts during production and before/after packaging.
* Verify Poka-Yoke implementation before processing approvals.
* Ensure strict adherence to engineering drawings, specifications, and control plans.
* Ensure customer requirements are fully implemented without any deviation.

**Rejection & Rework Management**

* Maintain rejection and rework records for each shift.
* Record and analyze rejection and rework parts on a shift-wise basis.
* Maintain rework part revalidation records.
* Initiate and maintain machine-wise rejection tracking.
* Identify recurring defects and implement corrective actions to reduce internal rework.
* Analyze defects such as improper nugget formation, rounding issues, burrs, and other quality concerns.

**Process Improvement & Coordination**

* Coordinate with Production and Maintenance teams for in-house rejection analysis and corrective action implementation.
