title: Core Operations - Senior Manager
description:
**About The Role**
We are hiring an
**Officer**
to support the end-to-end business analysis, deployment and operational transition of the
**Direct Custody model**
for
**Italy, France, Belgium, the Netherlands & Germany and other T2S markets.**
The role will support the translation of complex client, market and infrastructure requirements into clear business requirements, process documentation, test scenarios and implementation deliverables across securities settlement, cash and FX support, corporate actions, income, reconciliation and client/account setup.
  
  
The successful candidate will operate as a business analyst within the Direct Custody Business Design & Deployment team, supporting senior workstream leads and partnering with Product, Operations, Technology, Vendors, Market Infrastructures and Control Functions. Following implementation, the role may support subsequent market launches or transition into the relevant BAU Direct Custody operations.
  
  
**Why this role is important to us**
State Street is progressing a strategic transformation from sub-custodian arrangements to direct market participation across key markets. Project requires a coordinated operating model across T2S direct markets, non-direct and sub-custodian routes, multiple client archetypes, account structures and market-specific exception mechanisms.
  
  
**This Role Is Critical To**

* Supporting controlled direct-market implementation through accurate business analysis, requirements documentation, testing and operational-readiness execution.
* Supporting a scalable and integrated service model across settlement and market-facing activities, while aligning upstream processing with the existing operating model.
* Documenting client and market-specific complexity by distinguishing standard custody processing from exceptions requiring operating-model, technology and control closure.
* Building sustainable internal capability through documented processes, training, knowledge transfer and reusable implementation artefacts.

**Key Responsibilities (Direct Custody Aligned)**

* Market, Client and Account-Structure Analysis
* Analyse market rules, clients, transaction volumes, operating locations and service requirements across Italy, France, Belgium, the Netherlands, Germany and associated non-direct routes.
* Gather and analyse requirements for the different client archetypes and local market participants.
* Document operational requirements for Cash & Securities Account structures.
* Review existing roles and responsibilities and identify functional, process, control and ownership deltas against the target Direct Custody model.
* Target Operating Model and End-to-End Process Design
* Support the design and documentation of target-state processes aligned to State Street capabilities and the Direct Custody Target Operating Model across settlement, cash and liquidity, corporate actions, income, reconciliation and client servicing.
* Prepare process flows for T2S direct markets, including Euronext Securities Milan, Clearstream Banking Frankfurt and ESES markets, and document interfaces with non-direct or sub-custodian routes.
* Support definition of operating models for traditional OTC activity, ONEX flows, and applicable settlement or netting types.
* Identify process dependencies, hand-offs, exception ownership, service-level requirements and escalation paths across internal and external parties.
* Market-Specific Mechanisms and Exception Design
* Gather and document requirements, operating controls and design considerations for market specifics such as auto-collateralisation, auto-borrowing, French registration and deregistration and corresponding market notifications.
* Gather and document requirements, operating controls and design considerations for client specifics such as pool creation and specialised Hold & Release processing, including control points, eligibility logic and operational ownership.
* Support portfolio-transfer analysis and documentation of market-specific position reflection or rebuild requirements.
* Business Requirements, Technology and Vendor Engagement
* Prepare and maintain business requirements, user stories, process maps, functional clarifications and traceability across business, technology and vendor deliverables.
* Analyse vendor and application capabilities, document functional and integration gaps, and support definition of remediation or target-state solutions.
* Partner with Technology and vendors to document interface requirements, data mapping, messaging, workflow and exception-management capabilities.
* Review vendor Functional Solution Documents, record comments and gaps, and support senior business approval of the proposed design.
* Maintain scope, dependency, decision, action and issue logs, with clear impact assessment and timely escalation to workstream leads.
* Testing, Operational Readiness and Implementation
* Develop detailed test scenarios and test cases covering standard processing, client/market variants, exceptions, controls and end-to-end integration.
* Execute or coordinate system integration testing, market testing and user acceptance testing, including defect logging, remediation validation, retesting and regression testing.
* Maintain business-readiness assessments across operating procedures, staffing, access, static data, connectivity, controls, reporting and contingency arrangements.
* Prepare evidence and status reporting to support go-live and client-conversion decisions, risk assessment and stakeholder sign-off.
* Support implementation, stabilisation and structured handover into the Direct Custody BAU organisation.
* Risk, Controls, Compliance and Operational Resilience
* Document risk, compliance and governance requirements within the target operating model and solution deliverables.
* Support operational resilience and business-continuity readiness, including critical process documentation, recovery requirements and BCP knowledge transfer.
* Assist with business-function, control and organisational-framework setup, risk assessments and evidence requirements.
* Coordinate access, security and identity-governance requirements, including role mapping, approvals and segregation-of-duties evidence.
* Track regulatory, market-infrastructure and connectivity requirements through to closure before implementation.
* Procedures, Training and Knowledge Transfer
* Review existing procedures and Business Process Maps to determine applicability and gaps for new Direct Custody functions.
* Draft and maintain market- and application-specific SOPs, control procedures, operating guides and process documentation aligned to the Target Operating Model.
* Prepare and support delivery of training on market structures, applications, operating processes, exceptions and controls for implementation, BAU and BCP teams.
* Support structured handover, cross-training and maintenance of reusable artefacts for future Direct Custody market launches.
* Stakeholder Coordination and Delivery Support
* Coordinate assigned activities and provide analytical, documentation and subject-matter support to senior workstream leads and project resources.
* Partner across Product, Operations, Technology, vendors, Market Agents, Risk, Compliance, Client Service and other internal stakeholders.
* Prepare workshop materials, capture requirements, decisions and actions, and communicate operational matters clearly to stakeholders.
* Escalate business-design and readiness issues promptly, ensuring risks, dependencies and decisions are transparent and tracked to resolution.
* Promote standardisation, automation, operational resilience and continuous improvement across the regional and global Direct Custody operating model.

**Operational analytics and reporting**

* Build and maintain implementation dashboards covering requirements, design decisions, gaps, testing, defects, controls, training and operational-readiness milestones.
* Maintain implementation dashboards covering requirements, design decisions, gaps, testing, defects, controls, training and operational-readiness milestones.
* Produce concise workstream reporting on progress, risks, dependencies, decisions, remediation actions and readiness status.
* Support capacity, footprint and workforce planning for phased market delivery and transition into BAU operations.
* Use defect, exception and post-implementation metrics to support root-cause analysis and identify opportunities for control enhancement, process standardisation and automation.

**Qualifications And Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, Business, Technology or a related discipline; a Master's degree, MBA or relevant professional qualification is advantageous.
* Typically, 6-9 years of experience in securities services, custody, post-trade operations, business analysis, testing or transformation delivery.
* Good knowledge of securities settlement and familiarity with cash and liquidity, reconciliation, corporate actions and income processes within a global custody or direct custody environment.
* Practical understanding of T2S, European CSD/ICSD models, Dedicated Cash Accounts, settlement messaging, market cut-offs and exception management.
* Experience producing business requirements, user stories, process maps, test scenarios, test evidence, SOPs, training materials and project reporting.
* Experience supporting vendor engagement, application assessment, testing, implementation readiness, risk and control activities, and operational handover.
* Strong analytical, communication, documentation and stakeholder-coordination skills, with the ability to convert complex market requirements into clear and implementable deliverables.
* Working knowledge of SWIFT settlement and cash messaging and ISO 20022 is preferred

**About State Street**
Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.

title: Quality Control Officer
description:
**Position**

Quality Control Manager

**Department**

Quality Assurance & Quality Control

**Reporting To**

Head of Operations / Director

**Location**

Navi mumbai

**Role Objective**

To ensure that products manufactured by Anil Engineering comply with customer specifications, applicable quality standards, and regulatory requirements while driving continuous improvement initiatives to enhance product quality, reliability, and operational efficiency.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Quality Assurance**

- Establish, implement, and maintain quality control procedures and inspection plans.

- Ensure adherence to customer specifications, drawings, and applicable quality standards.

- Conduct incoming, in-process, stage-wise, and final inspections of products.

- Prepare and maintain inspection reports, quality records, and documentation.

- Ensure traceability and compliance with quality management systems.

**2. Process Improvement**

- Identify quality issues and implement corrective and preventive actions (CAPA).

- Conduct root cause analysis using quality tools such as 5 Why, Fishbone Diagram, and Pareto Analysis.

- Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance product quality and process efficiency.

- Monitor quality performance indicators and reduce rejection, rework, and customer complaints.

- Participate in Kaizen and Lean Manufacturing initiatives.

**3. Customer and Vendor Quality**

- Handle customer complaints and ensure timely closure through corrective actions.

- Coordinate with vendors and suppliers to ensure incoming material quality.

- Conduct supplier quality evaluations and audits.

- Support customer inspections, third-party inspections, and quality audits.

- Ensure compliance with customer-specific requirements.

**4. Team Management**

- Lead and supervise QC inspectors and quality personnel.

- Develop and implement training programs on quality standards and inspection procedures.

- Promote a culture of quality awareness and continuous improvement.

- Ensure effective communication and coordination with production, stores, and engineering departments.

**5. Quality Management System**

- Ensure compliance with ISO 9001 and other applicable standards.

- Support internal and external audits and ensure closure of audit observations.

- Maintain quality manuals, procedures, and records as per organizational requirements.

- Participate in management review meetings and quality improvement initiatives.

**SALARY - As per Interview**

description:
QA & Pharmacovigilance Executive
  
  
Summary
  
We are seeking a dedicated QA & Pharmacovigilance Executive to join our IT Services team. In this pivotal role, you will be responsible for upholding the highest standards of product quality and patient safety. Your expertise will ensure strict adherence to Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) and Schedule M regulations while managing critical pharmacovigilance activities. This position is essential for maintaining regulatory compliance, driving continuous improvement in quality systems, and safeguarding the integrity of our pharmaceutical operations.
  
  
Responsibilities
  

* Prepare and maintain comprehensive quality documentation and manage essential records with precision.
* Lead thorough investigations into process deviations and Out-of-Specification (OOS) results to identify root causes and implement corrective actions.
* Execute change control procedures to ensure all modifications to processes or systems are evaluated, approved, and documented appropriately.
* Manage the end-to-end handling of product complaints, ensuring timely resolution and regulatory reporting.
* Conduct vendor qualification assessments to verify that suppliers meet our rigorous quality and compliance standards.
* Oversee Quality Assurance and Pharmacovigilance functions to ensure alignment with internal protocols and external regulatory expectations.
* Monitor compliance with GMP guidelines and Schedule M requirements across all operational activities.
* Draft, review, and submit Adverse Event (AE) and Adverse Drug Reaction (ADR) reports in strict accordance with pharmacovigilance compliance mandates.

Requirements
  
  
**Requirements:**

* Proven experience in Quality Assurance and Pharmacovigilance within the pharmaceutical or healthcare sector.
* Strong proficiency in managing quality documentation and maintaining accurate record-keeping systems.
* Demonstrated ability to conduct effective investigations regarding deviations and Out-of-Specification findings.
* Solid understanding of Change Control processes and their application in a regulated environment.
* Experience in handling product complaints and coordinating with relevant stakeholders for resolution.
* Knowledge of vendor qualification processes and supplier assessment methodologies.
* In-depth familiarity with Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) and Schedule M regulations.
* Competence in preparing and filing AE/ADR reports while ensuring full compliance with pharmacovigilance standards.
* Minimum 1 to 3 years of relevant professional experience.
* Compensation package aligned with the market rate of ₹4 LPA.

title: Product Development Intern
description:
Product Development Intern

About us

Vansera Labs Private Limited is an early-stage fintech startup building the next generation of wealth and investing products for salaried professionals, entrepreneurs, family offices.

We're a small, fast-moving team that ships quickly, learns from real users, and cares deeply about making investing simpler, smarter, and more accessible. As one of our earliest hires, you'll have an outsized impact on the product and the company.

Who join us

1. Location: Malad West (Mumbai)
2. Type: Full-time internship, Onsite role
3. Timing: Monday to Friday (9:00 AM), Saturday (9:30 AM)
4. Compensation: Stipend (To be discussed during the Interview)+ Pre-Placement Offer (PPO) track for top performers
5. Duration: 6 months

**The role**

**We're looking for a Product Development Intern who loves to build and who understands that building well starts with breaking things on purpose. You'll begin with a heavy focus on testing and quality: putting our product through its paces, hunting down bugs, and making sure every feature behaves the way it should before it reaches real users.**

**As you get to know the product and codebase, you'll gradually take on more writing code, prototyping, and helping shape product decisions alongside our engineers.**

**This is a hands-on role with real ownership and a clear growth path: start by mastering the product through testing, then grow into building it. You won't be fetching coffee or shadowing from the sidelines you’ll be in the room where product gets made.**

**In your first few months (testing-focused):**

1. Test our product thoroughly new features, edge cases, and the money-critical flows where accuracy is everything.
2. Write clear, reproducible bug reports and work with engineers to get issues fixed.
3. Build and run test cases and checklists; help us catch problems before users do.
4. Learn how the product and codebase fit together by seeing it from every angle.
5. Validate that features match the spec and solve the user's problem.

**As you grow into the role (building-focused):**

1. Write and ship product features alongside our engineering team.
2. Turn rough ideas and user feedback into specs, mockups, and working prototypes.
3. Help automate testing and improve how we ship quality software.
4. Work with real financial data and third-party APIs (market data, KYC, payments, brokerage/depository integrations).
5. Talk to users, track metrics, and help define and prioritize the roadmap.

**What we're looking for**

1. Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in Computer Science Engineering, Design, or a related field or a self-taught builder who can show us what you've made.
2. Knowledge about fintech, equity markets, and investing, you don't need prior finance experience, just a willingness to learn fast.
3. A sharp eye for detail and a knack for finding the one thing that's broken, you're the person who notices when something feels off.
4. Patience and rigor: you're happy to test the same flow ten different ways to be sure it's right.
5. Some coding ability in at least one modern language/stack (e.g. JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, React, or similar) enough to grow into writing features over time. You don't need to be an expert; you need to be resourceful.
6. Strong communication skills and the ability to work closely with a small team.

**How to apply**

* Send your resume along on this email ID: brijesh.g@vanseralabs.com or apply here.

title: EY - GDS Consulting - AIA - Gen AI - Senior
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**AI QA – Senior**
**Educational qualification: BTech/Masters/PhD**
**The opportunity**
We are seeking an experienced AI QA Engineer with 5–9+ years of professional experience and deep expertise in AI testing, quality engineering, validation frameworks, and enterprise AI solution assurance. The ideal candidate should possess strong hands-on experience validating AI systems, Agentic AI workflows, RAG applications, conversational AI solutions, and enterprise-scale AI platforms.
  
  
The individual will play a key role in ensuring the quality, reliability, security, safety, and performance of AI systems while collaborating with AI engineers, architects, developers, and business stakeholders to establish robust quality assurance practices across AI and Generative AI implementations.
  
  
Important note: This role requires professional implementation experience in relevant AI technologies. Personal portfolio projects, cloned demos, certifications, or tutorial-based builds are helpful, but are not sufficient on their own.
  
  
Application guidance: Candidates should be able to clearly explain at least two relevant AI implementations, including the business use case, their direct contribution, the technical approach, and the outcome delivered.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, and execute comprehensive testing strategies for AI, GenAI, Agentic AI, and Agentic RAG systems.
* Validate Large Language Model outputs for accuracy, consistency, relevance, safety, and compliance requirements.
* Develop test frameworks and automation suites for AI services, copilots, AI assistants, and enterprise AI applications.
* Design and execute evaluation frameworks for RAG systems, retrieval pipelines, vector search solutions, and knowledge-based AI applications.
* Perform functional, integration, regression, performance, reliability, and scalability testing of AI-powered applications.
* Develop automated testing frameworks using Python to validate AI workflows, APIs, models, and orchestration pipelines.
* Validate prompt engineering approaches, agent workflows, tool usage patterns, and reasoning capabilities in Agentic AI systems.
* Execute AI model testing across conversational AI, multimodal AI, and intelligent automation solutions.
* Perform AI penetration testing, adversarial testing, prompt injection testing, jailbreak testing, and security validation activities.
* Assess AI solutions for bias, hallucinations, content quality, safety risks, and responsible AI compliance requirements.
* Validate integrations between AI systems, enterprise applications, APIs, databases, and cloud platforms.
* Utilize RAG evaluation frameworks such as Ragas to measure retrieval quality, answer faithfulness, relevance, and response effectiveness.
* Develop testing dashboards, quality metrics, defect reporting processes, and continuous quality improvement practices.
* Collaborate closely with AI engineers and architects to identify quality risks and improve operational reliability.
* Contribute to quality standards, governance controls, testing accelerators, reusable frameworks, and best practices.
* Stay current with advancements in AI testing, evaluation methodologies, Agentic AI, AI security, and emerging quality assurance technologies.

**Skills and Attributes:**
**Professional Experience**

* 5–9+ years of total experience, including 3+ years of directly relevant hands-on experience in AI/ML, applied AI, or GenAI systems.
* Proven experience building production, pre-production, or enterprise pilot AI applications.
* Strong hands-on depth in at least 3 of the following areas, with meaningful ownership in at least 2:

+ LLM application development.
+ Retrieval pipelines.
+ Agent or tool orchestration.
+ Evaluation, guardrails, or quality systems.
+ Model adaptation or fine-tuning.
+ Cloud deployment or optimization of AI applications.
+ Conversational AI.
+ Multimodal AI.
+ Backend engineering for AI systems.

* Strong software engineering foundation with ability to build reliable, maintainable AI services.
* Able to clearly explain direct contributions to delivered AI implementations.

**Educational Background**

* Bachelor’s/master’s degree in computer science, Data Science, Engineering, or related field.

**Technical Skills**

* Strong understanding of Large Language Models (LLMs), Generative AI, Agentic AI, and Agentic RAG systems.
* Hands-on experience validating and testing AI-powered applications and enterprise AI platforms.
* Experience developing AI testing strategies, validation frameworks, and automated test suites.
* Strong expertise in AI Model Testing, functional testing, regression testing, integration testing, and end-to-end quality validation.
* Experience performing AI penetration testing, adversarial testing, prompt injection testing, jailbreak testing, and vulnerability assessments.
* Strong understanding of prompt engineering validation, reasoning evaluation, and response quality assessment techniques.
* Experience implementing evaluation frameworks and quality measurements for Agentic AI workflows and AI agents.
* Hands-on experience with Ragas and similar evaluation frameworks for assessing retrieval quality, answer correctness, faithfulness, relevance, and grounding.
* Experience validating Agentic RAG systems, retrieval pipelines, and knowledge-based AI applications.
* Experience testing AI integrations across APIs, enterprise applications, databases, and cloud services.
* Strong understanding of AI observability, evaluation metrics, monitoring, and performance benchmarking.
* Experience working with Microsoft Azure AI Platform and Azure AI services.
* Hands-on experience developing automated test frameworks and validation utilities using Python.
* Familiarity with FastAPI-based services and API testing frameworks.
* Experience designing and executing automated API testing strategies.
* Knowledge of Responsible AI principles, AI safety controls, governance requirements, and regulatory compliance considerations.
* Experience evaluating hallucinations, bias, toxicity, safety violations, and model robustness.
* Strong understanding of software quality engineering, secure development practices, test automation frameworks, and CI/CD testing integration.
* Experience working with performance testing, scalability testing, reliability testing, and production-readiness validation.
* Familiarity with retrieval augmentation architectures, vector databases, embeddings, and enterprise search solutions.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and root-cause analysis skills.

**Soft Skills**

* Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to connect AI capabilities to business value.
* Strong communication and presentation skills.

**Other Responsibilities:**

* Contribute to end-to-end quality assurance activities across AI and GenAI engagements.
* Collaborate with AI engineers, architects, data scientists, and product teams to establish robust testing and validation practices.
* Participate in AI design reviews, risk assessments, model evaluations, and quality governance initiatives.
* Ensure AI solutions meet functional, security, compliance, governance, and business requirements before production deployment.
* Support development of reusable testing assets, automation frameworks, quality accelerators, and evaluation methodologies.
* Contribute to AI governance, Responsible AI, risk management, and compliance initiatives.
* Support presales, innovation initiatives, technical demonstrations, and client workshops where AI testing expertise is required.
* Provide mentorship to junior QA engineers and help establish AI quality engineering best practices.

**Why Join Us**

* Be at the forefront of AI-driven innovation across multiple client sectors.
* Work with global clients to drive real business impact.
* Collaborate with a team of AI experts, analytics leaders, and industry specialists in a highly entrepreneurial environment.

**What We Offer**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
  
  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

**Pre-Action Fire Suppression Systems**

+ Deluge valves
+ Pre-action valves
+ Detection and releasing panels
+ Solenoid valves
+ Supervisory and pressure switches

+ FM-200 (HFC-227ea)

+ Inergen
+ IG-541

+ Releasing control panels

+ Pressure switches

* Ensure compliance with:

+ NFPA 13
+ NFPA 72

+ FM Global requirements
+ Local fire authority regulations

* Follow site safety procedures and permit-to-work requirements.
* Conduct risk assessments before testing and system activation activities.

title: Global Marketing & Digital Wealth QA Engineer, Associate
description:
**About This Role**
The Team:
  
  
The Global Marketing & Digital Wealth organization at BlackRock is a forward-looking, globally connected team at the center of the firm’s most high-impact priorities. We are architects of growth, working across functions and markets to unlock opportunities and accelerate outcomes for the business. In collaboration with both internal and external partners, we design the conditions for success—delivering next-generation campaigns, brand platforms, communications, training, and client experiences. Our work is powered by world-class centers of excellence spanning content strategy, research & analytics, and digital platforms & experiences.
  
  
Within Global Marketing & Digital Wealth, the Global Digital team owns and transforms BlackRock’s client-facing digital properties—including BlackRock.com, iShares.com, and Advisor Center—as well as our email marketing channels. The team brings together product, design, engineering, and digital expertise to create connected, personalized experiences that help clients discover, understand, and engage with BlackRock.
  
  
**Role And Impact**
As more clients hold iShares and engage with BlackRock digitally, the quality of our client experiences matters more than ever. We are looking for a QA Engineer to join our global Digital Experiences team and help ensure that the experiences we build—guiding users through the purchase funnel, personalizing to their needs, and encouraging ongoing engagement—are reliable, accurate, and release-ready.
  
  
The successful candidate will own quality across the delivery lifecycle, from test planning and preparation through execution, automation, and CI/CD integration. They will bring a development-minded approach to testing and help evolve our QA practice toward an AI-assisted model that increases coverage and speed while reducing manual effort.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Planning
  
  

* Understand requirements and Jira stories; create test plans, assess test automation feasibility, and estimate, schedule, and plan testing activities.
* Use AI tools to analyze requirements and user stories, identify gaps or ambiguities early, and propose risk-based test coverage.

Test Preparation
  
  

* Analyze and understand scenarios and application flows, and prepare test scenarios and test cases for new functionality.
* Prepare test data and manually execute test cases to understand application flows.
* Use AI-assisted tools to generate and refine test scenarios, test cases, and synthetic test data, applying human review to validate accuracy and completeness.

Test Execution
  
  

* Execute new functional test cases for the current release, as well as manual and automated regression packs.
* Log defects and retest fixed defects.
* Apply AI to triage test failures, cluster related defects, and draft clear, reproducible defect reports.
* Leverage AI-enabled visual, accessibility, and content checks to catch regressions across pages, markets, and devices.

Test Scripting & Integration
  
  

* Develop test scripts according to the BlackRock framework and perform dry runs of automation scripts.
* Integrate automation with the CI/CD pipeline and complete a full run of automated scripts.
* Use AI coding assistants (e.g., GitHub Copilot) to accelerate test script development, refactoring, and maintenance, including self-healing of brittle locators.
* Help build reusable prompts, agent workflows, and standards that scale AI-assisted QA across the team, and measure their impact on coverage, cycle time, and defect leakage.

User Documentation
  
  

* Create and update user manuals.

**Core Skills**

* Quality mindset with a development background.
* Analytical mindset with the ability to grasp complex concepts easily.
* Comfortable working in an agile environment, fluent in English.
* Interested in continuously extending testing know-how.
* Curious and pragmatic about AI—applies it to improve quality and speed, while exercising sound judgment on AI-generated output.

**Qualifications**
Essential Skills and Experience
  
  

* 3-7 years of working experience in software testing or QA.
* Technology-based university degree or equivalent experience.
* Proven ability to assure the quality of developed software and code.
* Experience with at least one of the following frameworks: Playwright, Cypress, or Puppeteer.
* Experience with CI/CD environments.
* Experience with Jira/Azure Boards, Confluence, and Git.
* Hands-on experience using AI tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, or similar) in testing or development workflows.

**Desirable Skills And Experience**

* Practical knowledge of designing and developing test automation solutions.
* Experience with Azure DevOps.
* Strong hands-on knowledge of TypeScript and Python for test automation, scripting, and framework development.
* Familiarity with AI-native testing tools, Playwright MCP, or agent-based test generation and execution.
* Experience testing AI-powered features (e.g., chatbots or generative content), including evaluation of output accuracy and consistency.

**Our Benefits**
To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.
  
  
**Our hybrid work model**
BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.
  
  
**Guidance on AI use for candidates**
At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided
**guidance**
on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.
  
  
**About BlackRock**
At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.
  
  
This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.
  
  
To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.
  
  
BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.

title: Data Quality Engineer
description:

Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. We look for people who want to bring their best — bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one another and grow together. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what’s next.
  
  
**Overview**
As a Quality Engineer II, you will help ensure the quality and reliability of data solutions that support General Mills’ business. You will design and execute data and Extract, Transform, and Load (ETL) testing, validate data across systems, and partner with developers, business analysts, and stakeholders to deliver trusted insights. Reporting to the Manager – Quality Engineering, you will contribute to test strategy, continuous improvement, and delivery governance in a collaborative Digital and Technology environment.
  
  
**Key Accountabilities**

* Design and execute test plans, test strategies, test cases, and test data for data, extract-transform-load (ETL), business intelligence, and related technology solutions.
* Review data models, data mappings, architecture documentation, and requirements to identify test coverage, risks, and validation needs.
* Write and execute SQL queries (inside BigQuery) to validate, reconcile, and compare data across source systems, transformations, and data warehouse targets in Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
* Perform validation of end to end data flow from source to destination including reports (Tableau Reports).
* Perform Data Quality Checks, and document results, defects, evidence, and recommendations.
* Collaborate with developers, business analysts, data analysts, data engineers and stakeholders to clarify requirements, troubleshoot issues, perform root-cause analysis, and drive resolution.
* Use appropriate test automation tools for extract-transform-load validation and identify opportunities to improve testing efficiency.
* Maintain accurate testing documentation, status reports, productivity metrics, escalations, and delivery sign-offs while meeting project milestones and quality standards.
* Contribute to continuous improvement, knowledge sharing, stakeholder responsiveness, and a positive, adaptable team environment.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in computers and related fields.
* Experience: 5 to 7 years of experience in software quality engineering, data testing, extract-transform-load (ETL) testing, or a related area.
* Strong troubleshooting and root-cause analysis abilities.
* Strong understanding of the software development life cycle and multiple software engineering and testing methodologies.
* Proficiency in SQL, database testing, business intelligence testing, and data validation.
* Experience creating test cases and testing documentation from requirements or specifications, including for projects with limited development documentation.
* Familiarity with issue-tracking tools such as Jira or Azure DevOps.
* Well-developed communication and interpersonal skills, attention to detail, self-motivation, and the ability to work accurately in a fast-paced, changing environment.
* Ability to collaborate and communicate effectively with peers and stakeholders, with a continuous-improvement mindset and technical agility.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Advanced capability in agile testing, test management, and database testing, including SQL.
* Working knowledge of extract-transform-load processes, test design techniques, and test planning.
* Foundational knowledge of application programming interfaces, artificial intelligence and machine learning, dbt, and Monte Carlo.
* ISTQB certification.
* Experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and related services such as BigQuery or Cloud Functions.
* Knowledge of big data concepts, data warehouse structures, extract-transform-load processes, and data architecture principles.
* Basic knowledge of Python programing.
* Exposure to usage of GenAI tools in testing.
* Familiarity with continuous integration and continuous delivery pipelines and DevOps methodologies.
* Demonstrated alignment with General Mills values: do the right thing, play to win, grow and inspire, win as a team, and act boldly and move quickly.

**ELIGIBILITY**
Applicants must meet minimum age qualifications in the country in which the job is located.

description:
**Company Description**
**👋🏼We're Nagarro.**
We are a Digital Product Engineering company that is scaling in a big way! We build products, services, and experiences that inspire, excite, and delight. We work at a scale — across all devices and digital mediums, and our people exist everywhere in the world (18500+ experts across 39 countries, to be exact). Our work culture is dynamic and non-hierarchical. We are looking for great new colleagues. That is where you come in!
  
  
**Requirements**
Job Description
  
  

* Experience: 4+years
* Experience in software development, AI/ML engineering, or applied AI, including at least 1–2 years of hands-on experience building production-grade LLM applications.
* Expert-level proficiency in React.js for developing scalable, responsive, and reusable frontend applications.
* Strong hands-on experience with Python for AI development, automation, backend services, and API integration.
* Working knowledge of Java for backend services, REST API development, and enterprise application integration.
* Practical experience with LLM providers and APIs, including OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure OpenAI, Vertex AI, or equivalent platforms.
* Hands-on experience with prompt engineering, system prompts, structured outputs, JSON schemas, function calling, and tool integration.
* Strong understanding of LLM application development, AI assistants, agentic workflows, and enterprise AI integration.
* Experience with at least one LLM orchestration framework such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, LangGraph, Haystack, or equivalent.
* Hands-on experience implementing RAG pipelines, including embeddings, document chunking, retrieval tuning, grounding, and vector database integration.
* Experience with at least one vector database or search platform, such as pgvector, Pinecone, Weaviate, Chroma, FAISS, Azure AI Search, or Vertex AI Vector Search.
* Working knowledge of LLM evaluation methodologies, including evaluation datasets, regression testing, and frameworks such as RAGAS, DeepEval, Promptfoo, or LangSmith.
* Experience with FastAPI, Flask, asynchronous programming, Python packaging, and testing frameworks.
* Basic frontend development knowledge of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, along with backend API development experience.
* Knowledge of Shell scripting, Linux fundamentals, Git, CI/CD pipelines, and Docker.
* Exposure to at least one cloud platform such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud Platform.
* Basic understanding of Infrastructure Security concepts, including vulnerabilities, patch management, security logs, IAM, and access controls.
* Awareness of responsible AI and security practices, including prompt injection, data leakage, hallucinations, bias, and content filtering.
* Familiarity with SIEM platforms such as Microsoft Sentinel or Splunk, including the ability to write KQL or SPL queries for AI-assisted security detection and investigation.
* Basic understanding of Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM) and cloud security controls such as Network Security Groups (NSGs), Web Application Firewalls (WAF), IAM policies, and conditional access.
* Understanding of Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform or Bicep for cloud-native AI service deployment and configuration.
* Exposure to data privacy and regulatory requirements applicable in India, including the DPDP Act and RBI IT Risk Framework, particularly in handling personal and sensitive data within AI systems.
* Familiarity with vulnerability management concepts, including CVE, CVSS, EPSS scoring, CISA KEV catalogue, and patch prioritization workflows.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to debug LLM behavior across prompts, retrieval pipelines, and tool integrations.
* Ability to interpret evaluation metrics, application logs, and security telemetry to improve AI quality, reliability, and operational efficiency.
* Demonstrated ownership of AI solutions from prototype to production, including evaluation, observability, testing, and documentation.
* Strong learning agility and adaptability to evolving AI models, frameworks, tools, and development practices.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across technical and business teams.
* Certifications such as CISSP, Associate of ISC², CEH, Google Professional Machine Learning Engineer, AWS Certified Machine Learning – Specialty, Microsoft Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104), CCSP, or Google Associate Cloud Engineer are preferred.

**Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, and deploy LLM-powered features, AI assistants, and intelligent automation solutions for Infrastructure Security (InfraSec) workflows.
* Build AI-driven capabilities for vulnerability summarization, log triage, remediation recommendations, security policy reviews, configuration assessments, and natural-language querying of security data.
* Develop scalable, responsive, and reusable frontend applications using React.js for AI-powered internal tools and dashboards.
* Build and maintain backend AI services and APIs using Python, with Java-based backend development wherever required.
* Integrate LLM providers such as OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure OpenAI, Vertex AI, and open-source models into enterprise applications.
* Design and optimize prompt templates, system prompts, structured-output schemas, and function-calling workflows.
* Implement end-to-end Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, including document chunking, embeddings, vector store integration, retrieval optimization, and response grounding.
* Develop AI agents and tool-calling workflows using frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, LangGraph, Haystack, or equivalent technologies.
* Build evaluation frameworks, golden datasets, and regression test suites to measure LLM accuracy, hallucination rates, response quality, latency, and cost.
* Continuously improve prompt engineering and AI outputs through offline and online evaluations.
* Implement responsible AI and security controls, including prompt-injection protection, PII redaction, output filtering, rate limiting, audit logging, and access management.
* Integrate AI services with vulnerability scanners, ticketing platforms, SIEM solutions, monitoring tools, and other security infrastructure to enable automated workflows.
* Automate AI/ML operations activities such as data preparation, embedding refresh, evaluation runs, health checks, and monitoring using Python and Shell scripting.
* Test, debug, and optimize AI applications to ensure reliability, scalability, performance, and cost efficiency.
* Maintain technical documentation, source code repositories, deployment artifacts, and operational procedures.
* Collaborate with security, infrastructure, engineering, DevOps, and data teams to translate business requirements into practical AI-driven solutions.
* Apply infrastructure security principles and cloud security controls while designing and deploying AI services.
* Continuously explore emerging LLM models, frameworks, prompting techniques, and evaluation methodologies to improve solution quality and security posture.

**Qualifications**
Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field.

title: Specialist - Insurance Operations
description:
We are seeking a talented individual to join our Quality Assurance, part of our risk, reinsurance and capital business at Marsh. This role will be based in Mumbai. This is a hybrid role that has a requirement of working at least three days a week in the office.
  
  
**Specialist – Insurance Operations (Quality Assurance) (Grade C1)**
The Quality Review Analyst conducts detailed quality assessments of insurance operations processes to ensure accuracy, compliance, and client satisfaction. They document findings, assist with root cause analysis, and support continuous improvement initiatives.
  
  
**We will count on you to:**

* Perform quality reviews of transactions across insurance operations functions (placement, proof of insurance, surplus lines, contract review and policy admin).
* Apply standardized scoring rubrics to evaluate process compliance, data accuracy, and client outcomes.
* Document findings with clear narratives, evidence, and recommended corrective actions.
* Escalate high-risk issues to Supervisors and Program Manager; track remediation progress.
* Analyze trends and contribute to root cause analyses and action plans.
* Support calibration activities with peers to maintain consistent scoring.
* Assist with training needs, knowledge base updates, and onboarding materials.
* Maintain accurate QA records, reports, and dashboards; ensure data integrity and privacy.
* Collaborate with Operations and Compliance to drive improvements and share best practices.

**What you need to have:**

* Bachelor’s degree in business, Communications, Finance, or a related field; relevant experience may substitute.
* 1–3 years of QA or process-review experience in insurance or financial services.
* Strong attention to detail, analytical mindset, and ability to interpret policies and procedures.
* Proficiency with MS Office; familiarity with QA tools, data visualization, or case management systems is a plus.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Should be comfortable with 6.30pm – 3.30am

**What makes you stand out:**

* Experience with basic data analysis and creating concise QA reports.
* Knowledge of insurance product life cycles and regulatory considerations.
* Demonstrated ability to work with cross-functional teams.

Metrics & Success Indicators
  
  

* QA defect rates and severity distribution.
* Timeliness of QA reviews and reporting.
* Quality of remediation documentation and action follow-through.
* Contribution to process improvement initiatives.
* Client impact considerations in QA findings.

**Why join our team:**

* We help you be your best through professional development opportunities, interesting work and supportive leaders.
* We foster a vibrant and inclusive culture where you can work with talented colleagues to create new solutions and have impact for colleagues, clients and communities.
* Our scale enables us to provide a range of career opportunities, as well as benefits and rewards to enhance your well-being.

title: UI Path Automation Test Engineer
description:
**Project Description:**

UI path Developer for Testing Automation for thick clients will design, build and execute automated test solutions for the application platform using UiPath Test Suite, covering functional, regression, integration and upgrade testing. The role is responsible for converting the existing manual regression pack into a reusable, maintainable automation suite, integrating it into CI/CD pipelines, and providing reliable, repeatable test coverage across Loan IQ releases, enhancements and interfacing applications.

**Responsibilities:**

Test Automation Design & Development:

* Design, develop and maintain automated test scripts and reusable components using UiPath Studio / UiPath Test Suite.
* Build and maintain an object repository and data-driven automation framework covering thick client and web-based screens (thick client automation).
* Automate the regression pack across core modules – Customer, Deal, Facility, Outstanding, Drawdowns, Payments, Fees, Interest, Accruals, Notices and Batch processing.
* Parameterise test data and manage test data set-up to enable repeatable execution across SIT, UAT and pre-production environments

Test Execution & Defect Management:

* Plan and execute automated regression, smoke and sanity cycles for Loan IQ patches, hot fixes, version upgrades and enhancement releases.
* Analyse execution results, triage failures, distinguish genuine defects from script/environment issues and publish execution reports to stakeholders.
* Log, track and re-test defects in JIRA / Zephyr / ALM through to closure, working with development and vendor teams.
* Support integration testing of thick client interfacing systems (e.g. payment hub, messaging, reporting and downstream applications).

Framework, CI/CD & Maintenance:

* Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, GitLab or Azure DevOps to enable continuous testing.
* Maintain and refactor automation assets in response to thick clients version upgrades, configuration changes and screen changes.
* Manage version control of automation code and maintain scheduled unattended execution through UiPath Orchestrator.
* Identify and implement automation opportunities that reduce manual regression effort and shorten release cycles.

Documentation & Collaboration:

* Prepare and maintain test strategy, automation approach, test plans, test scenarios, scripts and requirement traceability matrices.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies and work closely with business analysts, developers, product owners, operations and vendor teams.
* Provide knowledge transfer and support to manual testers and business UAT users on automated test assets and results.

**Mandatory Skills Description:**

* 5 to 8 years in software testing, with a minimum of 3 years in test automation and hands-on experience testing with any thick client test cases automation experience and with computer vision of uipath.
* Thick client automation experience is a must.
* Hands-on experience with UiPath Studio, UiPath Test Suite and UiPath Orchestrator for automated functional and regression testing.
* Strong functional knowledge Deal Booking, Facility Booking, Drawdowns, Payments, Fees, Interest, Servicing, Notices and Batch processing.

title: Associate Lead Testing
description:

If working in an environment that encourages you to innovate and excel, not just in professional but personal life, interests you- you would enjoy your career with Quantiphi!
  
  
**QA Architect / Lead**
**Exp Range :**
8 - 13 Years
  
  
**Job location :**
Mumbai , Bangalore, Trivandrum
  
  
The QA Architect/Lead is responsible for the testing strategy and infrastructure across the entire platform. You will define the four-tier test framework (unit, integration, contract, acceptance), establish the conventions that ensure every spec-defined acceptance criterion has a verifying test, build out the validation infrastructure for parallel-run cutover from the existing Health Data Engine, and lead the load testing campaign that validates the platform's high-volume
  
  
capacity claims.
  
  
This role is technical-lead calibre. You will design test frameworks that data engineers consume, set the CI/CD gating policies that determine what merges and what doesn't, and lead the validation that determines when the platform is ready for production traffic. You will work in close partnership with the architect on spec-derived test conventions and with the data engineering team on the operational maturity of every component.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Define and own the four-tier test framework: unit (per spec acceptance criterion), integration (within-layer composition), contract (cross-layer schema and behaviour), and acceptance (end-to-end scenarios). Establish the conventions that distinguish them and the CI gates that enforce them
* Establish the spec-to-test traceability standard. Every acceptance criterion in a unit spec must have at least one named test that verifies it; test names reference the AC ID by convention; CI enforces coverage. The traceability is regulatory-defensible by design
* Build and maintain the test infrastructure — fixture management (HL7v2, CCDA, CSV, FHIR samples organized by source and DLQ scenario), DBT test runners, FHIR validator integration, Mini Cluster Flink test harnesses, HAPI test server harnesses for FHIR-Repository interceptor work, end-to-end test orchestration
* Establish synthetic test data conventions — no real PHI in fixtures; structured-but-synthetic patient names, identifiers, dates; reusable patterns for multi-source linkage scenarios; coverage of edge cases (NULLs, ECI merges, late-arriving data, validation failures)
* Lead the load testing campaign — design the eight to ten scenarios that validate sustained 50K msg/sec ingest, 150K msg/sec peaks, full DBT refresh at billion-row scale, 1,000 concurrent Starburst queries, 5,000 req/sec FHIR API, MDM degradation behaviour, and reprocessing during steady state. Lead execution; report against acceptance criteria
* Lead the parallel-run validation framework — for the 30-60 day cutover period when the new platform ingests alongside the existing Health Data Engine, establish what data is compared between the two systems, what tolerances are accepted, what reconciliation reports are produced, and what triggers a rollback decision
* Define performance SLOs and monitoring strategy. Every component has measurable latency, throughput, and freshness budgets. Build dashboards that operators use during incidents and that establish trend baselines over time
* Define and enforce CI/CD test gates — what blocks PR merge (spec lint, AC coverage, unit tests, integration tests, lint/format), what runs nightly (full integration suite, contract tests, slow scenarios), what runs in stage before promotion (acceptance tests). Codify in pipeline configuration and runbooks
* Build out test automation for FHIR profile validation — every Bundle published is validated against US Core 6.1 in CI and in the runtime path. Establish the FHIR validator deployment, the profile pack management, and the test patterns that prove conformance
* Lead testing for the bidirectional FHIR flow — verifying loop prevention via origin tagging works under load, that the FHIR-Repository egress interceptor captures every client-originated change, that the loopback Flink job applies write-authority rules correctly, and that no echoes propagate
* Establish testing patterns for MDM integration — synthesizing match/no-match/multi-match scenarios, validating ECI assignment correctness, validating ECI\_MERGE and ECI\_SPLIT handling end-to-end, validating DLQ routing for MDM failures
* Lead validation of data quality at every layer — DBT test suites for CDM, freshness checks at every layer boundary, anomaly detection for ingestion patterns, governance integration for quality metric publication to Atlan
* Mentor data engineers on test authorship under the spec-driven development framework. Tests are part of every PR; their quality is part of the PR review; the QA lead sets the bar
* Participate in incident response and root cause analysis. Drive test additions that prevent recurrence — every production incident becomes a new acceptance criterion in the affected spec and a new test in the suite

**Required Skills And Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related quantitative field
* 8+ years of QA experience with at least 3-5 years focused on data quality, data warehousing, or data platform testing, and 2+ years in a lead or architect role
* Demonstrated experience defining and operating QA strategies for large-scale data platforms in cloud environments — preferably GCP
* Strong Python and SQL skills for test framework authorship. Familiarity with pytest and dbt-test conventions required
* Experience with data validation across batch, streaming (Kafka), and event-driven pipelines
* Experience with dbt — specifically dbt's native testing framework, dbt-expectations or dbt-utils packages, custom test authorship via macros, and source freshness checks
* Experience testing Iceberg or other open-table-format-backed warehouses — schema evolution edge cases, partition handling, snapshot semantics, and CoW vs MoR behavioral differences
* Experience with healthcare data quality testing — HL7v2 parsing edge cases, FHIR profile conformance validation, terminology binding validation, master data quality
* Experience designing and executing load tests for data platforms at scale — JMeter, Gatling, Locust, or custom load generators. Familiarity with realistic load profile design (not just throughput, but representative mix of operations)
* Experience with parallel-run validation and reconciliation between legacy and replacement data systems
* Strong CI/CD experience — GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or Cloud Build. Ability to design pipeline gates and integrate test execution into PR and release workflows
* Excellent analytical, communication, and collaboration skills. The role works across engineering, architecture, governance, and customer stakeholder groups

Nice-to-Have Skills
  
  

* Experience with the HL7 FHIR validator, Inferno, or HAPI FHIR validation tooling
* Atlan experience for data quality metric publication and governance integration
* Experience with chaos engineering or resilience testing for streaming data systems
* Experience integrating spec-driven or contract-first frameworks with QA workflows
* Test management tools experience (TestRail, Zephyr, qTest)
* Experience working in HIPAA-regulated environments — synthetic PHI generation, audit trail validation, regulatory test evidence
* QA or cloud platform certifications

*If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us*
*!*

title: Agent Engineer - Evals and Harness
description:
Lexsi Labs is the leading frontier AI lab focused on building aligned, interpretable, and safe superintelligent systems. While that is the vision, the mission is to build safety aware autonomous systems in the extreme near term. Our research work spans areas like AI alignment methodologies, interpretability-led system design, and foundational model research across structured, tabular, and new autonomous system designs. We published about 25+ papers in the past 15 months across leading conferences including ICLR, ICML, WWW, IJCNN, MICCAI and EurIPS. Our labs are located in India (Mumbai and remote), Paris, and London.

We operate with a flat structure, high autonomy, and a strong bias toward engineers who take full ownership of what they build, from architecture to production behavior.

The Role

Our current sprint on building autonomous systems for complex problems, across software engineering, data science, and AI research, involves building the harness, execution substrate and evaluation system, and each is designed to run inside a customer's environment rather than ours.

This role sits underneath all three agents. The coding agent, the data science agent and the AI engineering agent look different from the outside, but they are the same system underneath: a loop that plans, acts, observes, recovers, and knows when to stop. You will build that shared layer, and the evaluation system that tells us whether any change to it made things better. Both halves matter equally. A harness we cannot measure is a harness we cannot improve.

****What you'll work on:****

Harness

* The core agent loop and its execution model, covering orchestration, concurrency, sub-agent coordination, cancellation, timeouts, checkpointing and resume.
* Context and state management for long-running tasks, including retention, compaction, and how an agent reasons over what it has already done.
* The shared tool protocol, its schemas, versioning, and the internal libraries every agent team builds against.
* The execution substrate. Sandboxed environments that are reproducible, snapshot-able and resource-bounded, and that behave identically for a repository task, a training run and a data analysis.
* Failure semantics. Retry policy, partial failure, idempotency, and the distinction between a recoverable error and a task that should stop and hand back.
* The trace schema every agent emits, which serves at once as our debugging surface, our training signal, and the audit record our customers keep.
  
  

Evals

* Task suites for each agent type, built from real work rather than synthetic benchmarks, and the infrastructure to run them at scale in parallel.
* Verifiers and scoring. Deterministic checks where the task allows it, model-graded rubrics where it does not, and calibration of the graders themselves.
* Regression gates that run on every harness change, with cost and latency accounted alongside quality.
* The statistics to say a result is real. Seeds, variance, pass@k, confidence, and knowing how many runs are needed before anyone claims an improvement.
* Turning observed production failures into permanent test cases.
* Tooling for how we work. Trace inspection, replay, and diffing one run against another.
  
  

You will work across all three agent teams and closely with our research team on evaluation design, post-training and interpretability of agent behavior.

What We Are Looking For

This is a systems and infrastructure role. Most of the difficulty here is concurrency, state and measurement, not prompting.

* Strong software engineering fundamentals and advanced Python. You have shipped and operated production services, not only written them.
* Concurrency and distributed systems. Async execution, worker pools and queues, retries and idempotency, backpressure, cancellation, and reasoning clearly about what happens when a step fails halfway through.
* Containers and sandboxing. Docker and OCI internals, resource isolation, reproducible environments, and an understanding of why a job that passes locally fails in a sandbox.
* Test and CI infrastructure. You have built test harnesses, run large suites in parallel, and dealt with flakiness as an engineering problem rather than an annoyance.
* Measurement literacy. Comfort with variance, sampling and significance, and healthy skepticism toward benchmark results including your own.
* Observability instincts. Distributed tracing, structured logging, and building the inspection tooling that makes non-deterministic systems debuggable.
* You debug systematically. You find out what actually happened rather than adjusting things until the symptom disappears.
* You are comfortable when problems are loosely specified and ownership is assumed rather than assigned.
* Experience with evaluation or benchmarking work for AI systems is a strong plus.
* Experience with agentic systems, LLM inference and serving, or developer tooling is a plus.
* Open source contributions we can read are a plus.
  
  

We are hiring several engineers for this team at a range of experience levels, including engineers early in their careers who have strong fundamentals and want to work on agents from the infrastructure side.

We move quickly and expect candidates to do the same. We value substance over polish and execution over rhetoric.

* Master of Business Administration

The SAP PP/QM Tester is responsible for validating and ensuring the quality of SAP Production Planning (PP) and Quality Management (QM) solutions within a manufacturing environment. The role involves preparing test scenarios, executing test cycles, identifying defects, and supporting SAP S/4HANA implementation projects to ensure business requirements are met and processes function as designed.
  
  
****Key Duties And Responsibilities****- Participate in SAP S/4HANA implementation and testing activities for PP and QM modules.
- Analyze business requirements, functional specifications, and process designs for manufacturing operations.
- Design, prepare, and execute test cases, test scripts, and test data for PP and QM processes.

- Validate manufacturing processes including:
- Material Master
- Bill of Materials (BOM)
- Routings
- Work Centers
- Production Orders
- MRP
- Demand Management
- Quality Inspection
- Quality Notifications
- Batch Management

- Functional Testing


* Integration Testing
* End-to-End Business Process Testing
* User Acceptance Testing (UAT)
* Regression Testing
* Defect Management and Tracking
* Test Scenario, Test Case & Test Script Preparation
* Test Data Creation and Validation
* Defect Retesting and Closure
* Cutover and Go-Live Validation

* Collaborate with Functional Consultants, Business Users, Developers, and Integration Teams to resolve issues.
* Support data validation and reconciliation activities during migration and cutover phases.
* Prepare test execution reports and provide status updates to project stakeholders.
* Support hyper care and post-go-live validation activities.
* Ensure compliance with quality standards and testing best practices.
* Exposure of SAP FIORI Applications

**Minimum Requirements**
**Education**
Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or related discipline.

Remote

We are seeking an experienced Quality Engineer to own product quality across our orthopedic surgical instrument manufacturing business. In this role, you will drive first-pass yield up and customer rejects down. You will lead root cause investigations, close the gap between our inspection results and our customers' incoming inspection, and work closely with our manufacturing partners to raise the quality of the parts we receive from them.

·      Partner process control: Get control plans, PFMEA, in-process checks and SPC in place at partner sites for critical features, so defects are caught at the source.

·      Reduce rejects and improve yield: Track first-pass yield, scrap, rework and customer rejects by part and supplier; lead projects that measurably bring them down.

·      Root cause and CAPA: Lead structured investigations (8D, 5-Why, Ishikawa) into nonconformances and customer complaints; own corrective actions through to verified effectiveness.

·      Drawing and GD&T review: Review customer drawings per ASME Y14.5 before production; flag unspecified dimensions, ambiguous datums and malformed callouts with the customer up front.

·      Quality system: Keep our processes and records aligned with ISO 13485 and FDA QMSR (21 CFR 820) expectations as a registered contract manufacturer — NCR/MRB, device history records, document control and audit readiness.

·      Customer communication: Act as the technical quality contact for international customers — investigation reports, SCAR responses and clear written updates.

**Required Qualifications:**

·      B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical, Production, Industrial or Metallurgical Engineering, or a related field.

·      At least 5 years of hands-on quality engineering experience in medical device, pharmaceutical equipment or aerospace manufacturing.

·      Strong command of GD&T (ASME Y14.5) and reading complex engineering drawings.

·      Proven record of quality projects that increased throughput or reduced rejects, with numbers to show for it.

·      Excellent communication skills in English, both written and verbal.

·      Ability to work on multiple projects across different industries.

**Preferred Skills:**

·      Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt, or a Lean manufacturing certification.

·      Experience working within a customer's quality system as a supplier or contract manufacturer.

·      Experience with orthopedic instruments or implants, and stainless steel (420, 17-4 PH, 465) or titanium parts.

·      Supplier quality engineering experience, driving improvement at external manufacturers.

**Perks & Benefits:**

·      A high-impact role with direct ownership of quality outcomes for Global medical device customers.

·      The chance to shape CCPL's supplier quality program and how we work with our manufacturing partners.

·      Work in a collaborative, close-knit team with direct access to leadership.

·      Competitive compensation aligned with industry benchmarks, with strong potential for career and salary growth.

title: Senior Analyst, AI Implementation
description:
Third Bridge is a leading global research firm established in 2007, with a team of over 1,500 employees worldwide dedicated to
**fueling decisions with expert insights**
. We accelerate and enhance decision-making for investors and business leaders by unearthing unique expert insights across multiple sectors, geographies, and topics.
  
  
For nearly 20 years, we’ve helped clients access knowledge on demand from experts, in-person and through our Library covering over 65,000 companies.
  
  

* Role Summary

Third Bridge produces primary research for private equity, credit, and corporate clients globally. The Private Markets Strategy function owns how that content is built, deployed, and scaled. We are integrating AI across the content lifecycle — from expert identification and vetting through transcript generation, Company Briefs, and demand-signal detection. The AI Implementation team turns those initiatives into working systems.
  
  
**You Will Work Across Three Broad Surfaces**

* Internal content and operations systems — tooling and data workflows that make our content cleaner, faster to produce, and easier to discover across the business.
* Client-facing AI products — the next generation of AI-powered research experiences delivered to institutional clients.
* Demand and coverage intelligence — systems that detect where content is thin, where client demand is concentrating, and which companies, sectors, or themes to prioritise next.
* What You Will Do
* Own one or more workstreams end-to-end: scope the problem, design the approach, build it in Python, and carry it through to a stable, monitored production system.
* Design and productionise prompt-based workflows, retrieval pipelines, and evaluation harnesses, with an eye on quality, cost, and reliability at scale.
* Partner directly with Technology, Product, Compliance, and Data teams to integrate builds into the wider stack and clear the path to deployment.
* Set engineering standards for the team — code review, testing, documentation — and coach Analysts through their work.
* Diagnose and resolve data-quality and performance issues, and make pragmatic trade-offs when internal systems impose constraints.
* Contribute to the team's roadmap by surfacing high-value opportunities and flagging risk early.
* What This Role Is Not
* Not a pure research role. The emphasis is on shipping and integrating reliable systems, not novel model development.
* Not an end-to-end infrastructure ownership role. You build in close partnership with the teams that own the underlying platforms rather than owning that infrastructure yourself.
* Not a people-management role at this level, though you will mentor Analysts and are expected to lead by technical example.
* What You Bring
* 2–5 years of experience building and shipping software or data/ML systems in a production environment. Consulting (MBB or Big 4) or high-growth startup experience alongside solid technical delivery is a plus.
* Strong Python and a track record of taking work from prototype to production, including testing, monitoring, and iteration.
* Practical experience with LLM workflows — prompting, retrieval, and evaluation — and good judgement about where they do and do not fit.
* Ability to work independently within a workstream, make defensible trade-offs, and communicate them clearly to technical and non-technical partners.
* Comfort operating across functions and translating fuzzy business problems into concrete, shippable systems.
* Early signs of leadership — mentoring juniors, raising the bar on quality, and owning outcomes rather than tasks.
* How You Will Be Measured
* The reliability, quality, and business impact of the systems you own end-to-end.
* Autonomy — how much can be handed to you with confidence, and how well you manage ambiguity.
* Effectiveness of your cross-functional partnerships and the strength of the Analysts you coach.
* Career Path

The natural progression is toward the AI Implementation Lead (AVP) track, subject to performance, sustained ownership of production systems, growing cross-functional influence, and demonstrated coaching of Analysts.

* Competitive Compensation: Enjoy a competitive salary reflective of your skills and experience.
* Time Off: Benefit from 18 days of paid time off (PTO), 8 fixed holidays, 1 floating holiday, and 8 casual leaves. PTO increases with tenure.
* Learning & Development: Receive a personal development reimbursement yearly for customised learning programs. Additionally, a dedicated budget supports studies and job-related qualifications.
